rows.title: 2-bedroom flat with a Lake Como view terrace
rows.why_great: €85,000 for a home above Lake Como. 69 m² (85 m² commercial) on the 2nd floor: living room with fireplace, 2 bedrooms, 1 bathroom, two balconies and a 15 m² terrace looking straight at the lake. Good condition, ready to move in, partly furnished, shared garden. About 7 minutes from the lake and 1 h from Milan Malpensa airport.

rows.title: Bright bungalow with a garden near Blyth town and beach
rows.why_great: A charming one-bedroom semi-detached bungalow with a modern kitchen, a bright living room, a shower room, off-street parking and a lawned garden, close to Blyth town centre and its long sandy beach on the Northumberland coast. Listed at £75,000, about €88,500. Anyone can buy a home in the UK. Stamp duty depends on whether it will be your only home.

rows.title: Corbières village house with a modern kitchen
rows.why_great: A three-storey village house of 58 m² in Durban-Corbières, in the wine hills behind Narbonne: living room with a modern open kitchen, two bedrooms, an office and two cellars. The Mediterranean beaches are about 30 minutes away.

rows.title: Holiday flat with a big sea-view terrace and garden in Calabria
rows.why_great: A 47 m² ground-floor flat in the Residence Solemar at Torremezzo di Falconara Albanese, on the Tyrrhenian coast of Calabria. Bright living room with kitchenette opening straight onto a large tiled terrace with bougainvillea and a wide view over the sea, plus a bedroom and a bathroom. Good condition. Asking €29,000.

rows.title: 2009 duplex house with a private garden in a spa village
rows.why_great: A semi-detached duplex house built in 2009 in Encausse-les-Thermes, a spa village at the foot of the Pyrenees: living room opening onto a 200 m² private garden, open kitchen, two bedrooms upstairs, terrace and utility room.

rows.title: 198 m² family villa near the Limfjord for under €80k
rows.why_great: A well-kept 1973 villa with 198 m² and five bedrooms on a quiet street in Ranum, near the Limfjord and Vilsted Lake. Terrace and garden; Løgstør is 7 km away. Listed at DKK 595,000. EU citizens who move to Denmark can buy freely; others need permission from the Ministry of Justice.

rows.title: Red-brick house near the harbour in Frederikshavn
rows.why_great: A 75 m² red-brick house in Frederikshavn, close to the harbour, with a garden and terrace and the sea in view from the neighbourhood. Ferries to Gothenburg and Oslo leave from town. Listed at DKK 695,000. EU citizens who move to Denmark can buy freely; others need permission from the Ministry of Justice.

rows.title: Furnished seaside flat a few steps from the beach at Acqualadrone, Messina
rows.why_great: A 40 m² flat on the first floor of a 1985 building at Acqualadrone, on the northern tip of Sicily near Messina, with the sea right across the road. Living room with kitchenette, a bedroom, a bathroom and a terrace looking over the Tyrrhenian. Sold fully furnished and ready to move in. Asking €30,000.

rows.title: Whitewashed stone house in Locorotondo, Puglia, ready to move into
rows.why_great: A typical detached 'cummersa' of about 45 m² on Via Porta Nuova in the historic centre of Locorotondo, one of Italy's most beautiful villages in the Itria Valley. Ready to move into and in excellent structural condition: living area and guest bathroom below, a bedroom with a period fireplace above. Works as a home or a holiday let.

rows.title: Renovated family home with a view of Mount Fuji
rows.why_great: Built in 2001 and renovated inside and out: 3 bedrooms plus a storage room in 87.6 m², on a 199 m² plot in Fuji city, Shizuoka, with Mount Fuji visible from the first floor. Parking for three cars. Asking price ¥11,800,000. That is about €66,700. Foreigners can buy homes in Japan with no restrictions.

rows.title: Renovated half-timbered villa in a Lolland village
rows.why_great: A single-storey half-timbered villa from 1850 with exposed beams, modernised and ready to move in, in a small village in southern Lolland between Rødby and Holeby. 91 m², thermal windows and a modern kitchen. Listed at DKK 625,000. EU citizens who move to Denmark can buy freely; others need permission from the Ministry of Justice.

rows.title: Village house with a sea-view balcony in Pollina, 30 minutes from Cefalù
rows.why_great: A 50 m² terraced village house with 2 rooms and 2 bathrooms in Pollina, one of the prettiest hill villages of northern Sicily, in the Madonie park. Balcony and rooftops with a sweeping view down to the sea and the coast towards Cefalù; the nearest beach is about 15 minutes away. Good condition, sold privately. Asking €30,000.

rows.title: Fjord-view villa with a big garden in Thy for €66k
rows.why_great: 115 m² with three bedrooms on a 758 m² plot looking over open country and the Limfjord, near Hurup in Thy. Originally from 1850 and now modernised: bright rooms, a cosy living room with a wood stove and nothing to do before you move in. Listed at DKK 495,000. EU citizens who move to Denmark can buy freely; others need permission from the Ministry of Justice.

rows.title: 211 m² country house with fields as far as the eye can see
rows.why_great: A characterful home with high ceilings and 211 m² in Frøslev on Mors, on a 1,069 m² plot with open fields all around. Ready to move in, with bright living rooms and a modern kitchen. Listed at DKK 695,000. EU citizens who move to Denmark can buy freely; others need permission from the Ministry of Justice.

rows.title: Renovated stone house with a lake-view balcony above Lake Como
rows.why_great: A semi-detached stone house in a quiet old village in San Siro, on the western shore of Lake Como near Menaggio, renovated a few years ago and sold fully furnished. Ground floor: living room with a fireplace and a separate kitchen. Upstairs: two bedrooms, one opening onto a small balcony with open views over the lake and the mountains, and a bathroom with a tub. Small private courtyard, public parking a short walk away, south-east facing, gas heating. The price was cut from €130,000 to €95,000 (-27%). The lake is about 5 minutes away; Lugano Airport about 40 minutes and Milan Malpensa about 1 h 10. At about €1,580/m² it is roughly 40% below the San Siro average for houses (€2,690/m², RealAdvisor, Oct 2026).

rows.title: Furnished log cabin on stilts with a deck in the Hida forest
rows.why_great: A 1999 log cabin of 53 m² on a 332 m² freehold plot in a managed forest estate in Shokawa, Takayama. Open living room under a loft, log-walled kitchen and bathroom, and a wooden deck in the trees. Sold furnished with appliances, water included in the estate fee of about ¥11,000 a month. Asking ¥2 million, about €11,400.

rows.title: 114 m² town house with a courtyard near Limoux
rows.why_great: In Espéraza, a lively village with shops 15 minutes from Limoux, in the upper Aude valley: 114 m² with a 31 m² open kitchen-living room, a utility room, a private interior courtyard, two large bedrooms and two more rooms to use as you like.

rows.title: 137 m² village house with a roof terrace near Carcassonne
rows.why_great: A dual-aspect house with 137 m² in Azille, a Minervois wine village near Carcassonne: four bedrooms, a living room with a working fireplace, a large kitchen, a games room, an office, a garage and a private roof terrace that is not overlooked.

rows.title: Master builder's villa with full basement and 100 m² garage
rows.why_great: 180 m² under roof: 113 m² of living space plus a full 67 m² lower floor, and a huge 100 m² brick garage, on the island of Mors in popular Øster Jølby. Modernised throughout and ready to move in. Listed at DKK 695,000. EU citizens who move to Denmark can buy freely; others need permission from the Ministry of Justice.

rows.title: Mountain chalet with a wood stove and a loft in the Hida forest
rows.why_great: A 1992 two-storey chalet of 93 m² on a 558 m² freehold plot in a managed holiday-home estate in Shokawa, Takayama (Gifu). Double-height living room with a wood stove and an open loft, fitted kitchen, a tatami bedroom, and it is sold with what is inside. Estate fee about ¥11,000 a month. Asking ¥1.3 million, about €7,400.

rows.title: Fully modernised 1920 house with a new roof near Randers
rows.why_great: Totally modernised between 2018 and 2020: new roof, farmhouse windows and an open living space, 88 m² in Jennum next to Spentrup, between Randers and Hobro. Front garden, carport and a 26 m² garage; school and supermarket in the next village. Listed at DKK 698,000. EU citizens who move to Denmark can buy freely; others need permission from the Ministry of Justice.

rows.title: 157 m² family villa with two bathrooms and energy label B
rows.why_great: A villa in green surroundings near Sandholt Lyndelse on Funen: four bedrooms, two bathrooms and a garden room, on a 1,006 m² plot. A new heat pump lifted it to energy label B. Listed at DKK 595,000. EU citizens who move to Denmark can buy freely; others need permission from the Ministry of Justice.

rows.title: 186 m² energy-A villa with open views on the island of Mors
rows.why_great: A modernised villa of 186 m² on a 1,424 m² plot in Flade on Mors, the island in the Limfjord, looking over open fields. Energy label A2010, four bedrooms and a designer kitchen; the village has a green, a playground and some of Denmark's best nature around it. Listed at DKK 745,000. EU citizens who move to Denmark can buy freely; others need permission from the Ministry of Justice.

rows.title: Mountain cabin with hot-spring water on tap, a big deck and a far sea view in Izu
rows.why_great: A single-storey 1982 cabin of 66 m² on a 1,587 m² freehold plot at 880 m in the Amagi Kogen woods above Ito, on the Izu peninsula. Wood-lined living room with a stove, a sunroom and a wide wooden deck looking through the trees to Mount Komuro and the sea. Hot-spring water is already piped into the house (about ¥9,100 a month). Asking ¥1.8 million, about €10,200.

rows.title: Villa with fjord views and solar panels on 1,700 m² in Hygum
rows.why_great: 157 m² brick villa set back from the road on a 1,693 m² plot in peaceful Hygum, near Lemvig, with views towards the water. Solar panels and a pellet boiler keep energy costs down; bright modernised kitchen and open-plan dining. Listed at DKK 675,000. EU citizens who move to Denmark can buy freely; others need permission from the Ministry of Justice.

rows.title: Sea-view apartment with pool on Bulgaria's Black Sea coast
rows.why_great: A finished one-bedroom apartment of 53 m² in a gated complex in Byala, 50 km south of Varna on the Black Sea, with a panoramic terrace looking over the pool and the sea. Entrance hall, living room with kitchenette, bedroom and shower room; sold ready to move in.

rows.title: Vaulted stone home with terrace in Cisternino's old town
rows.why_great: In the white historic centre of Cisternino, Puglia: about 45 m² under stone vaults with an entrance hall, living room with sofa bed, kitchenette and bathroom, and a staircase up to the bedroom level and a private terrace. Furnished and ready to use.

rows.title: Renovated Lake Como flat with a lake-view balcony, 100 m from the shore
rows.why_great: An 80 m² top-floor flat in an old palazzo in Gravedona, 100 m from the Lake Como promenade. Fully renovated in 2022 (wiring, roof, boiler) and sold with made-to-measure furniture: open kitchen with island, living room with a balcony looking over the rooftops to the lake and the mountains, one large bedroom that sleeps up to 5, shower room. Asking €195,000, about €2,438/m².
rows.location_name: Gravedona ed Uniti, Lake Como, Lombardy

rows.title: Blue 1907 cottage with 9-foot ceilings and a new kitchen
rows.why_great: A 1907 cottage with two bedrooms in about 83 m², freshly painted outside, with 9-foot ceilings, open beams, brand-new flooring and an open kitchen and dining area. Covered porch, private back yard and a detached garage, in Freeport, Illinois. That is about €83,700.

rows.title: Move-in-ready village house by the famous canal locks
rows.why_great: A comfortable 52 m² village house in Rogny-les-Sept-Écluses, known for its seven historic canal locks: a living room with an insert fireplace, a fitted and equipped kitchen, a bathroom and two attic bedrooms, plus a garden with a wooden shed. No major work needed.

rows.title: Beautifully styled two-bed home with an open fireplace
rows.why_great: About 72 m² of beautifully presented rooms in Shildon, County Durham: a feature open fireplace, a stylish four-piece bathroom and two double bedrooms, thoughtfully improved by the current owners and ready to move into. Listed at £70,000, about €82,600. Anyone can buy a home in the UK. Stamp duty depends on whether it will be your only home.

rows.title: Four-level village house with sea and mountain views in Sangineto, Calabria
rows.why_great: A 108 m² house over four levels in the old village of Sangineto, on the Riviera dei Cedri in Calabria, with views over the rooftops to the sea and the mountains. Living room with a modern kitchen, a wood-clad bedroom with period tiled floor and balcony, an attic with a second kitchen, two bathrooms and a storage room. Good condition. Asking €22,000.

rows.title: Energy-label A townhouse with solar panels and a battery
rows.why_great: A modernised 1½-storey house of 120 m² in Stenum, near Brønderslev, rated A2010 for energy. Heat pump, solar panels with a battery pack and new windows from 2018, so running costs are very low. Small easy garden, ready to move in. Listed at DKK 695,000. EU citizens who move to Denmark can buy freely; others need permission from the Ministry of Justice.

rows.title: Renovated house near the Limfjord at Doverodde
rows.why_great: A beautifully modernised 115 m² house from 1870 on a 776 m² plot at Doverodde in Thy, close to the fjord, culture and nature. In very good condition and usable as a year-round or flexible holiday home. Listed at DKK 698,000. EU citizens who move to Denmark can buy freely; others need permission from the Ministry of Justice.

rows.title: Townhouse with garden 15 minutes from Aalborg
rows.why_great: A well-planned 88 m² terraced house with carport in the village of Vaarst, close to Aalborg and the sea. Three bedrooms, bright open kitchen-dining and a private garden. Listed at DKK 695,000. EU citizens who move to Denmark can buy freely; others need permission from the Ministry of Justice.

rows.title: Furnished beachfront studio 50 m from a sandy beach in Calabria
rows.why_great: A 40 m² studio on the 6th floor (with lift) of a seafront building at Falerna Marina, Calabria, 50 m from a long sandy beach with beach clubs. Sea-facing, sleeps up to 4, sold with fridge-freezer and washing machine. About 15 minutes from Lamezia Terme international airport. Asking €28,000.

rows.title: White country house with field views at the end of a lane
rows.why_great: Peaceful 85 m² home on a quiet cul-de-sac in Kaas, near Pandrup and the North Sea beaches of Blokhus. Modernised and ready to move in, with big windows over the fields and a sunny terrace. Listed at DKK 745,000. EU citizens who move to Denmark can buy freely; others need permission from the Ministry of Justice.

rows.title: Cosy stone house with pellet stove and views near Limoux
rows.why_great: A stone village house of 73.8 m² ten minutes from Limoux: a 20 m² kitchen and living room, a lounge with a pellet stove, a bedroom with shower room, and an attic bedroom of 18 m². Fibre internet and very nice views from the bedrooms. Ready to live in.

rows.title: 'La Casa Felice': a 2-bed home in an Umbrian hill village for €48k
rows.why_great: A two-level terraced home of about 77 m² in the heart of San Venanzo, a hilltop village in Umbria, with two bedrooms, a living room with a wood stove and a fitted kitchen. Shops and services are a short walk away, Orvieto is half an hour by car.

airport.name: Perugia San Francesco d'Assisi – Umbria International Airport

rows.title: Wooden villa in Kita-Karuizawa that you can rent out as a holiday home
rows.why_great: A single-storey 1990 villa of 60 m² on a 410 m² freehold plot in a well-kept estate in Kita-Karuizawa, Gunma. Wood-lined living room opening onto a balcony in the trees, two tatami rooms, fitted kitchen. Listed as usable for holiday lets. Estate fee about ¥58,000 a year. Asking ¥4.5 million, about €25,600.

rows.title: Fully renovated village house in Árchez, Málaga's Moorish village
rows.why_great: Completely reformed traditional village house of about 56 m² over three levels in central Árchez, in the Axarquía: open living room with kitchenette, mosaic-tiled shower, two bedrooms (one with a Juliet balcony), beamed ceilings and wooden windows. Half an hour from the beaches of Torrox and Nerja.

rows.title: Modern rustic Ozarks cabin minutes from the river
rows.why_great: Built in 2008: a two-bedroom cabin of about 104 m² with knotty-pine walls, an open living and dining room and a fitted kitchen, on open land minutes from the North Fork of the White River, Bryant Creek and the Mark Twain National Forest. Full-time home or weekend retreat. That is about €84,500.

rows.title: Year-round wooden chalet with garden and pool access near Lake Zurich
rows.why_great: Two bedrooms, an open living and kitchen area and a bathroom in about 50 m², on a 189 m² pitch in the Ricken leisure park above Lake Zurich. It comes with air conditioning for heating and cooling, a new washing machine and toilet, and a private parking space. The park has a swimming pool and two tennis courts, with hiking and cross-country skiing from the door. Ready to use now. The pitch is rented: about CHF 5,832 a year (2026) including water and basic fees, plus electricity, and a new pitch contract is signed with the operator. It is a holiday and weekend home; it cannot be registered as a main residence. Asking price CHF 74,900, about €80,700. Buying in Switzerland as a non-resident foreigner is limited by the Lex Koller rules; ask the agent whether you qualify before you go further.

rows.title: Wood-lined holiday home in a seaside estate with a pool and tennis courts, Wakayama
rows.why_great: A 1996 two-storey holiday home of 70 m² in the Kinosato estate in Inami, Wakayama, popular with sea anglers. Wood-lined living-kitchen with big windows over the hills, a tatami room, and parking. The estate pool and tennis courts are 70 m away and the coast is a short drive. Asking ¥3.5 million, about €19,900.

rows.title: Front-line beach flat in Juan Dolio with pool and jacuzzi
rows.why_great: A lived-in, ready apartment on the front line of the beach in Juan Dolio: 105 m², 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, living-dining room, balcony, laundry area and one parking space. The building has a pool and jacuzzi on the sea, covered and open terraces, 24-hour security, a water tank and a generator. About 30 minutes from Las Américas airport. Asking US$250,000 (about €223,600), around US$2,380/m².
rows.location_name: Juan Dolio, San Pedro de Macorís

rows.title: Sea-front ground-floor flat with a 50 m² terrace and overflow pool in Protaras
rows.why_great: A 2020 sea-front ground-floor apartment in Protaras, a stone's throw from Green Bay and Cavo Maris beach and about 5 minutes from Fig Tree Bay. 85 m² inside plus a 50 m² part-covered terrace with panoramic sea views, 2 bedrooms (one en suite), sold fully furnished, with private covered parking, a communal overflow pool and a gym. Reduced from €500,000 to €470,000.

rows.title: Furnished beachfront flat on Playa Las Ballenas, Las Terrenas
rows.why_great: A 2-bedroom apartment in Bonita Village with direct access to Playa Las Ballenas, one of the best beaches in Las Terrenas, on the Samaná peninsula. Sold fully furnished with an equipped kitchen, ready to live in or rent out straight away. The residence has a large pool in tropical gardens, 24-hour security and power, private parking, laundry and housekeeping, a few minutes from the town centre. About 30 minutes from El Catey airport. Asking US$225,000 (about €201,200), marked as a limited-time offer.

rows.title: Cedar-lined forest cabin renovated in 2023, with a deck and a big loft room
rows.why_great: A 2004 cabin of 75 m² on a 165 m² freehold plot in a forest holiday village in Agano, Niigata. Cedar walls throughout, 3 rooms plus a 20-tatami loft room, a wooden deck and parking. Renovated in December 2023; hot spring water can be connected as an option. Asking ¥4 million, about €22,800.

rows.title: Furnished front-line flat in Juan Dolio with a sea-view balcony
rows.why_great: A 2023 apartment on the front line of Juan Dolio beach with direct beach access, sold furnished and ready to move in. 82 m² on the first floor with lift: 2 bedrooms, each with its own bathroom and walk-in closet, living and dining room, kitchen with breakfast bar, laundry area and one parking space. The balcony looks along the whole Juan Dolio coastline. Air conditioning, generator, water tank and 24-hour security. Asking US$210,000 (about €187,800).
rows.location_name: Juan Dolio, San Pedro de Macorís

rows.title: Oceanfront 3-bed flat in Juan Dolio with wide Caribbean views
rows.why_great: A renovated oceanfront apartment in Juan Dolio, on the Caribbean coast east of Santo Domingo, sold ready to live in. 98 m² inside plus terraces (about 200 m² in total), 3 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms and a private parking space. The balcony looks straight over the beach and the sea. About 30 minutes from Las Américas airport and under an hour from Santo Domingo. Asking US$250,000 (about €223,600); the agent's text also quotes US$300,000, so confirm the price.
rows.location_name: Juan Dolio, San Pedro de Macorís

rows.title: Furnished townhouse with a private pool, 100 m from the sea in Protaras
rows.why_great: A 2009 townhouse 100 metres from the coastline of Protaras, sold fully furnished and ready to live in or rent out. 94 m² on a 155 m² plot with its own swimming pool: open-plan living with a new kitchen and breakfast bar, a renovated shower room downstairs, and two double bedrooms upstairs, the main one with a balcony over the pool. Bars and restaurants are within walking distance. At about €3,720/m² it is roughly 27% below the Protaras median asking price (€5,136/m², index.cy, October 2026).

rows.title: Renovated two-storey villa in the Mount Akagi woods, Gunma
rows.why_great: A 1996 villa of 70 m² on a 302 m² freehold plot on the lower slopes of Mount Akagi, Maebashi. Renovated: bright living-kitchen, tatami room and a bedroom upstairs, parking. Golf courses, a campsite and hot springs nearby. Estate fee about ¥48,000 a year including water. Asking ¥4.9 million, about €27,900.

rows.title: Ready 2-bed flat steps from the beach in Coral Bay, with pool and sea views
rows.why_great: A ready-to-move-in 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom apartment a few steps from the Blue Flag beaches of Coral Bay, west of Paphos. 84 m² with a modern fitted kitchen, a bright open living area and a private balcony with sea views for the sunsets. Gated complex with a large communal pool in landscaped gardens and private parking. About 25 km from Paphos airport. At about €4,060/m² it is roughly 18% below the Paphos median asking price (€4,923/m², index.cy, October 2026).

rows.title: Red-brick villa a short walk from Odden harbour and the Kattegat
rows.why_great: A well-planned red-brick villa in Havnebyen on Sjællands Odde: 106 m² of living space plus an 18 m² built-in sunroom and a 28 m² garage, on a 781 m² plot. Open kitchen and living room onto a tiled terrace, three bedrooms, heat pumps. The fishing harbour, marina and beaches are close by. At 650,000 kr. it is about 76% of its public valuation. Copenhagen is about 1 h 27 away.

rows.title: Village villa at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac, new windows 2017
rows.why_great: A charming, well-kept 125 m² villa over two floors at the end of a closed road in the village of Lundby near Skælskør, next to a green area with almost no traffic. Kitchen-diner, a big bright living room, bathroom and a bedroom downstairs, more bedrooms upstairs; windows replaced around 2017, carport and shed. 745,000 kr., about 43% below the price per m² of the 4230 area. Copenhagen is about 1 h 30 away.

rows.title: Ready-to-live forest villa with two balconies near Lake Misasa, Nagano
rows.why_great: A 1991 villa of 106 m² with 3 rooms on a 897 m² freehold plot in the Misasa holiday estate, 330 m from Lake Misasa and 25 minutes by car from Sakudaira bullet-train station. Bright living room opening onto a balcony in the larches, two floors that work as separate units. Ready to move in; estate fee ¥12,000 a year for residents. Asking ¥2.8 million, about €15,900.

rows.title: 151 m² single-storey villa on a 2,500 m² plot, 12 min from Billund
rows.why_great: A single-storey villa with 151 m² of living space and 5 rooms in Hinnum, just outside Grindsted, on a big 2,500 m² plot with nature, peace and quiet all around. Kitchen-diner, utility room and a straightforward layout. The price was just cut to 695,000 kr., about half the price per m² of homes in the 7200 area. Billund, LEGOLAND and Billund Airport are about 12 minutes by car.

rows.title: Well-kept villa with energy label C and an updated kitchen
rows.why_great: A well-maintained villa 4 minutes from Ruds Vedby, on an 847 m² plot sheltered by tall trees. Inside: an updated kitchen, nice living rooms and three bedrooms over two floors; energy label C. School, nursery, shops and the train station are close. 649,000 kr. is about 89% of its public valuation. Copenhagen is about 1 h 19 by car.

rows.title: Move-in-ready villa with views of fields and Lyderslev Church
rows.why_great: A move-in-ready villa in Lyderslev on Stevns with three bedrooms, a living room and kitchen together as the heart of the house, and open views over the fields to Lyderslev Church. Quiet village setting, 87 m² on a 279 m² plot that is easy to look after. 695,000 kr., about a third below the price per m² of the Store Heddinge area. Copenhagen is about 1 h 13 by car.

rows.title: Bungalow 3 minutes' walk from the beach in Wakayama, new facade in 2025
rows.why_great: A 2000 steel-frame bungalow of 59 m² with 3 rooms on a 116 m² freehold plot, a 3-minute walk from Kirime beach and 1 km from the station. New exterior cladding in May 2025, sunsets over the sea, good fishing. The 50 m² plot next door can also be bought. Asking ¥4.8 million, about €27,300.

rows.title: 182 m² family villa between forest and water, 84 min from Copenhagen
rows.why_great: A two-storey family villa in Orehoved with 182 m² of living space, 8 rooms and open views over the fields from several rooms, on a 1,788 m² plot close to the coast and the woods. It is listed at 595,000 kr., about 62% of its public valuation and roughly half the price per m² of homes in the 4840 area. School, nursery and shops are nearby, and the E47 motorway takes you to Copenhagen in about 1 h 25.

rows.title: 127 m² period house with an extra outbuilding, 73 min from Copenhagen
rows.why_great: A sharply priced period house from 1877 in the village of Skørpinge near Slagelse, with 127 m² of living space, 4 rooms and an outbuilding finished to living standard (not approved as a home). Countryside setting, with Slagelse and the motorway close. At 745,000 kr. it is about 89% of its public valuation and well below Slagelse prices. Copenhagen is about 1 h 13 by car.

rows.title: Charming 141 m² villa with energy label C and a heat pump
rows.why_great: A characterful 141 m² villa in Tystofte, near Skælskør, with a bright living room, a practical kitchen, several bedrooms on two floors, a utility room with its own entrance and a sunny courtyard. It is heated by a modern air-to-water heat pump and has energy label C, rare at this price. 698,000 kr. is about 70% of its public valuation. Copenhagen is about 1 h 30 by car.

rows.title: Fully renovated 3-bedroom house in Gifu with a brand-new kitchen
rows.why_great: A 69 m² house with 3 bedrooms and a 20 m² living-dining room on a 127 m² freehold plot in Akutami, Gifu city. Fully renovated in 2024: new kitchen, toilet and vanity, new floors and walls, plus free parking. Ready to move in. Asking ¥3.3 million, about €18,800.

airport.name: Nagoya Airport / JASDF Komaki Air Base

rows.title: Renovated, freshly painted house near the train and motorway
rows.why_great: A house the seller has renovated step by step, now well kept and freshly painted throughout: 120 m² with a large living room, a functional kitchen, a bathroom and two bedrooms downstairs, plus another bedroom and a flexible extra space upstairs. Utility room with its own entrance and an easy garden with terrace. Quiet village setting close to the motorway, train, shops and school in Nørre Alslev. 625,000 kr. Copenhagen is about 1 h 25 by car.

rows.title: Red-brick country house with four bedrooms and a closed garden
rows.why_great: A neat red-brick house with a tiled roof in Øster Kippinge on Falster: 132 m², a bright living room, a practical kitchen with cellar and pantry, one bedroom downstairs and three upstairs (two with lofts). Small outbuilding and a lovely closed garden. Nørre Alslev, with school, shops and the train, is 10 minutes away; woods and water a short bike ride. 745,000 kr. Copenhagen is about 1 h 29 by car.

rows.title: Solid red-brick villa with wide field views, 78 min from Copenhagen
rows.why_great: A solid red-brick villa from 1918 in Klarskov with a classic exterior, an efficient layout over 98 m² and 5 rooms, and open views over the fields. A bright ground floor, room for a home office or kids' rooms, and extra space for storage or a workshop. 695,000 kr. is about 84% of its public valuation and about half the price per m² of the Vordingborg area. Copenhagen is about 1 h 18 by car.

rows.title: Swedish villa with a glazed porch and big garden in Gnarp
rows.why_great: A well-kept six-room villa with four bedrooms, a glazed porch, a living-room stove and a wood-burning kitchen range, on a 1,050 m² plot. Bathroom and drainage renewed in 2010, heat pumps installed. Asking SEK 945,000, about €82,000.

rows.title: Charming renovated flat by Parque Taoro with its own street entrance
rows.why_great: A cosy flat in San Fernando, one of the nicest parts of Puerto de la Cruz, next to Parque Taoro and a 10-minute walk from Lago Martiánez, shops and restaurants. It has two entrances, one straight from the street and one through the building. A large bedroom with a separate dressing room, a newly renovated bathroom and a bright open living room and kitchen. Communal pool, sold furnished.

airport.name: Tenerife Norte-Ciudad de La Laguna Airport

rows.title: 3-bed duplex with a 227 m² private garden and pool, near Corralejo
rows.why_great: A 76 m² duplex in the Origomare estate in Majanicho, a quiet spot by the north coast minutes from Corralejo's beaches, shops and restaurants. Three bedrooms (two on the ground floor), two full bathrooms, a fitted kitchen and a bright living-dining room opening onto a wide terrace and a 227 m² private garden. Communal pool with sea views.

rows.title: Bright 2-bed flat with open views and a palm-fringed pool in Cumbre del Sol
rows.why_great: A bright flat in Cumbre del Sol, Benitachell, with open, clear views over the hills: two large double bedrooms with built-in wardrobes, a full bathroom, a cosy living-dining room with a fully equipped open kitchen and split air conditioning, and a 15 m² terrace. Lift, communal pool among palms and gardens. Jávea and Moraira are 10 minutes away.

rows.title: Studio with communal pool 950 m from La Mata beach, Torrevieja
rows.why_great: A bright 29 m² studio in the Torresol 2 gated complex, with an enclosed balcony, fitted kitchen and appliances, communal pool and gardens. About 950 m on foot to La Mata beach. Running costs are low, about €518 a year in total. Asking €99,000.

rows.title: 2-bed, 2-bath flat with sea and Montgó views in La Sella golf
rows.why_great: A bright flat in La Sella, the quiet golf estate near Dénia, in an aparthotel-style development with a communal pool, well-kept gardens and a year-round concierge. Two bedrooms and two full bathrooms (one en suite), a large terrace and views of the sea, the Montgó natural park and the golf course. Covered parking space included. A show flat is available to visit.

rows.title: Renovated beachfront bungalow with a corner terrace and fireplace
rows.why_great: A just-renovated corner bungalow on the front line of L'Almadrava beach in Els Poblets, next to Dénia: 80 m² over two floors, a big corner terrace partly covered with an awning, a fireplace, an open kitchen to the living-dining room, two double bedrooms (one with a balcony), two shower rooms and air conditioning upstairs and down. Communal pool and gardens, outdoor parking, sold furnished.

rows.title: Corralejo flat with a sunny terrace over three pools and palm gardens
rows.why_great: A bright upper-floor flat in one of Corralejo's most wanted areas, in a quiet, well-kept complex with 24-hour security. One double bedroom, a bathroom with walk-in shower and a living room with an equipped kitchen. Its private terrace looks straight over the three communal pools and the palm gardens.

rows.title: Beachfront flat on the Mar Menor with a tourist licence
rows.why_great: A bright 70 m² two-bedroom flat just 10 m from the Mar Menor beach with no road in between, renovated in 2018. First floor with a lift, sea-view balcony, and it is sold with a tourist rental licence. Asking €116,500, about €1,664/m².

rows.title: Renovated 2-bed flat with a glazed sun room and a private roof terrace
rows.why_great: A modern, fully renovated flat ready to move into in El Toscal, 5 minutes from Puerto de la Cruz: two bedrooms, a light-filled glazed living-dining room with views over the rooftops to the sea and the green hills, a new kitchen and bathroom. Upstairs, a rooftop terrace with its own room and washing machine. A small, quiet building with shops, schools and buses a few minutes away.

airport.name: Tenerife Norte-Ciudad de La Laguna Airport

rows.title: Ground-floor flat with a terrace on the pool, parking and storage
rows.why_great: A furnished ground-floor flat in the La Caleta complex, Parque Holandés: 2 bedrooms, a living room with open kitchen and a terrace that faces the communal pool. A parking space and a storage room in the basement are included in the price. Corralejo and its beaches are a short drive away.

rows.title: Sea-view penthouse 2 minutes' walk from the beach in Dénia
rows.why_great: A lovely penthouse with sea views in one of the best parts of Dénia, a 2-minute walk from Les Bovetes beach, with supermarkets, restaurants and a pharmacy all around. Two bedrooms, a bright living room, terraces with views over the rooftops to the Mediterranean, a communal pool and parking. Sold furnished. Fourth floor without a lift for now (a lift project is awaiting approval).

rows.title: Top-floor loft with an 82 m² cathedral living room in Lodève
rows.why_great: A fully renovated 215 m² loft on the top floor of a historic building, below the Larzac plateau. The cathedral living room is over 82 m² with exposed timber beams, light from both sides and a pellet stove. Five bedrooms including a master suite, a 12 m² kitchen and a 31 m² terrace with panoramic views over the Lergue. Energy class B. Asking €285,000, about €1,326/m².

rows.title: Sea-view flat by the marina with a corner terrace and heated pool
rows.why_great: One of the largest flats with the best sea views in the Aguamarina complex in Golf del Sur: 91 m² with a double bedroom with en-suite bathroom, a guest toilet and a living room with a renovated open kitchen. Both rooms open onto a corner terrace with wonderful views of the sea, the marina and the heated communal pool. Steps from the promenade, golf courses and restaurants.

rows.title: Furnished flat in a garden complex with a big pool, tennis and sea views
rows.why_great: A furnished one-bedroom flat in a well-kept complex in the Botánico area of Puerto de la Cruz, among palm trees and tropical gardens, with a large pool, a tennis court, a play area, a porter and a lift. The bedroom and living room open onto a balcony with views of the gardens and the sea. Puerto de la Cruz has mild, spring-like weather all year.

airport.name: Tenerife Norte-Ciudad de La Laguna Airport

rows.title: 2-bed flat between Jávea and Moraira with lagoon pools, 700 m from the cove
rows.why_great: An 85 m² flat in Cumbre del Sol, Benitachell, between Jávea and Moraira, with open views over the Moraira valley: two bedrooms, a bright living-dining room with an open kitchen, a 15 m² partly covered terrace, air conditioning, heating and a parking space. Built in 2007, in good condition. Two lagoon-style pools, big gardens and a social club; the Cala Llebeig cove is 700 m away.

rows.title: Sea-view flat between two seas in La Manga, with pool and parking
rows.why_great: A 104 m² two-bedroom flat in Veneziola, between the Mar Menor and the Mediterranean, with a private terrace facing the sea and its sunsets. Air conditioning, fitted wardrobes, separate kitchen, lift, included parking space, and a complex with pool, padel court and gardens. Asking €179,900.
rows.location_name: Veneziola, La Manga del Mar Menor, Murcia

rows.title: Fully renovated 2-bed flat in a palm-lined pool complex near Corralejo
rows.why_great: A 72 m² flat in the La Caleta complex in Parque Holandés, renovated top to bottom with new installations, a designer kitchen and bathroom and two bright bedrooms. It opens onto a private terrace a few steps from the communal pools and gardens. Sold furnished. Corralejo's beaches and dunes are 10 minutes away, with around 245 good-weather days a year.

rows.title: Fully renovated penthouse with a sunny terrace over the pools
rows.why_great: A bright penthouse in Costa del Silencio, a few steps from Montaña Amarilla, fully renovated with quality materials: two double bedrooms, an elegant living-dining room with a modern open kitchen and a new bathroom. Its 12 m² terrace looks over the complex's pools and gardens and the rooftops to the sea. Lift, communal pools.

rows.title: Designer-renovated flat with a big shaded terrace in Costa del Silencio
rows.why_great: A first-floor flat in the Frontera-Primavera complex in Costa del Silencio, south Tenerife, finished with wood panelling and a vertical garden: living room with an equipped open kitchen and air conditioning, a separate bedroom, a bathroom with shower and a large terrace with an awning. Communal pool and gardens. Sold furnished. Tenerife South airport is 10 minutes away.

rows.title: Renovated, furnished studio in Golf del Sur with pool and gardens
rows.why_great: A bright 53 m² studio in Golf del Sur, renovated and sold furnished: an open living and sleeping space with a sofa bed, built-in wardrobes, a fully equipped open kitchen, a full bathroom and a balcony terrace. The private estate has large gardens, a communal pool, a restaurant and a supermarket, with the golf courses and the seafront promenade nearby.

rows.title: Renovated flat 100 m from the sea with a garden terrace and pool
rows.why_great: A charming flat just 100 metres from the sea in Costa del Silencio, fully renovated and sold furnished: a cosy living room with an integrated modern kitchen and built-in appliances, opening onto a 15 m² front terrace with garden. 81 m² in total, with a large bedroom in two areas that can become a second bedroom, a spacious bathroom, a pool with ocean views and a parking space.

rows.title: Renovated, furnished flat in a garden resort with pool near Tavira
rows.why_great: A 68 m² flat in the Colina Verde Resort in Moncarapacho, among olive trees, palms and lawns a few kilometres from the Algarve coast between Tavira and Olhão. Recently renovated and sold fully furnished: a large, bright living and dining room flowing into an open kitchen, a bedroom and a bathroom, with the resort's pool and gardens outside. Faro airport is 25 minutes away.

rows.title: Tastefully renovated flat steps from Montaña Amarilla
rows.why_great: A flat in the Chasna complex in Costa del Silencio, renovated in 2025 with real taste: a large bedroom plus a smaller second room, a bright living room, and a new kitchen and bathroom. A few steps from Montaña Amarilla, the volcanic cove where people dive, swim and walk the coastal paths. One of the sunniest corners of Tenerife.

rows.title: Two-level beach flat in Antigua Bay, freshly done up, with pool and sea views
rows.why_great: A two-level flat in the Antigua Bay complex in Caleta de Fuste, with two bedrooms, a full bathroom with a stone-tiled walk-in shower, a bright living room and a modern kitchen, air conditioning and furniture included. The complex has a large pool and lawn looking out to the sea, and the sandy beach of Caleta de Fuste is a short walk away. 15 minutes from Fuerteventura airport.

rows.title: 1920 house on the main square of Corpa with four bedrooms and a terrace
rows.why_great: A 1920 village house in the heart of Corpa, next to the town hall and the 17th-century palace on the main square. 145 m² usable: a large living room, independent kitchen, four bedrooms, two full bathrooms, a terrace and a storage room. 15 km from Alcalá de Henares and 50 km from Madrid.

rows.title: Mountain chalet with pool, two en-suite bedrooms and big views
rows.why_great: Single-storey chalet in the hills 6 minutes from Villar del Arzobispo, with privacy and lovely views: a 35–40 m² living-dining room, two bedrooms each with its own bathroom, air conditioning, a private pool, garden and parking. Paved road except the last 300 metres of dirt track. 198 m² built.

rows.title: 134 m² flat a few steps from Chinchón's famous Plaza Mayor
rows.why_great: A bright, fully exterior first-floor flat of 134 m² a few metres from the Plaza Mayor of Chinchón, one of the prettiest towns near Madrid: living room with big windows, independent kitchen with pantry, a very large main bedroom with dressing area, a separate office and a full bathroom. Cross ventilation. Sold furnished.

rows.title: Flat renovated less than a year ago in central Aranjuez
rows.why_great: Exterior, bright two-bedroom flat in a central street of Aranjuez, renovated less than a year ago: open living room with wooden ceiling, new kitchen, fitted wardrobes and air conditioning. 60 m². Shops and services on the doorstep, and the royal palace and gardens close by.

rows.title: Bright duplex with a 13 m² terrace and open views in Terrassa
rows.why_great: A very bright duplex in Terrassa, 22 km from Barcelona, with 2 bedrooms, a full bathroom, an open kitchen with a stone bar, air conditioning and, upstairs, a 13 m² terrace with open views. 80 m². Terrassa has trains and the FGC line to central Barcelona.

rows.title: Four-bedroom duplex with fireplace and a private patio in the Sierra Oeste
rows.why_great: Ready-to-move-in duplex over three levels in Cadalso de los Vidrios: a bright living-dining room with fireplace opening onto a private patio, an independent kitchen and toilet, two bedrooms with fitted wardrobes and a bathroom, and an attic floor with two more bedrooms and a second full bathroom. 116 m², 4 bedrooms.

rows.title: Renovated 220 m² town house with a roof terrace with views and a wine cellar
rows.why_great: A renovated four-storey house in the centre of Capellades: wine cellar in the basement, a ground-floor room that works as a studio or shop, 4 double bedrooms, dressing room, 3 bathrooms, a top-floor living-dining room with kitchen and a private roof terrace with views of the hills. 220 m². Train to Barcelona from the town.

rows.title: Wood-lined duplex in Gironella's old town with fireplace and a balcony with views
rows.why_great: A warm, tastefully renovated duplex in the old town of Gironella with countryside and mountain views and every service 2 minutes on foot: living-dining room with an old fireplace, a long balcony with views, a large wood-lined bedroom, two bathrooms and a big attic bedroom upstairs. Sold furnished. 131 m².

rows.title: Country house with pool, fireplace and valley views, 30 minutes from Valencia
rows.why_great: A private chalet in La Cañada de Benito, 10 minutes from Llíria and 30 from Valencia city on the CV-35. Living-dining room with fireplace and air conditioning, kitchen plus summer kitchen, 3 bedrooms, a pool with wide views over the valley and mountains, garden and parking. 138 m² including storage rooms.

rows.title: Terraced house with a private pool, two patios and a garage
rows.why_great: Terraced house in Zarza de Tajo, off the A-3 about an hour from Madrid, with a front patio, a back patio with a private pool and an independent garage. Ground floor with kitchen, bathroom and a living-dining room opening onto the pool; three bedrooms and a second bathroom upstairs. 136 m².

rows.title: New 2025 detached house on a 1,500 m² flat plot near the San Juan reservoir
rows.why_great: Detached house built in 2025 and barely used, in the Costa de Madrid estate of San Martín de Valdeiglesias. About 70 m²: open living room with a kitchen island and large windows to the garden, a big suite bedroom with walk-in shower and a guest toilet. Heat-pump heating. The flat 1,500 m² plot has room for a pool. Low running costs.

rows.title: Restored 1925 village house with beams, fireplace and a private patio
rows.why_great: A 1925 village house restored in 1995 and kept in perfect condition: exposed wooden beams, a living-dining room with fireplace, an independent kitchen, a suite bedroom with its own bathroom opening onto a private patio, a second bedroom with balcony and an attic room with views of the church tower and the mountains. 118 m², 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms. About an hour west of Madrid.

rows.title: Modern 2009 duplex in the mountains of the Sierra Oeste, ready to move in
rows.why_great: A spotless duplex in a 2009 building in Robledondo, a mountain village of the Sierra Oeste de Madrid surrounded by nature: a bright living-dining room with large windows downstairs, and two bedrooms and two full bathrooms (one en suite) upstairs, with open views of the countryside. 96 m².
rows.location_name: Robledondo, Santa María de la Alameda, Madrid

rows.title: Hillside chalet with mountain views and a sea glimpse, plus a guest house
rows.why_great: A chalet on high ground 5 minutes from Godelleta, surrounded by nature, with open views of the mountains and, on clear days, the sea in the distance. About 140 m² in two separate buildings: a main house of about 100 m² with 3 bedrooms, bathroom, kitchen and a bright living room with fireplace, plus a second building. Garden, parking, sold furnished.

rows.title: Chalet on a 1,526 m² plot with pool, fireplace and fruit trees
rows.why_great: Chalet of about 100 m² on a 1,526 m² plot in Turís, 27 km from Valencia: 3 bedrooms, walk-in wardrobe, a living-dining room with open modern kitchen and a cosy sitting area with a wood fireplace. Outside: two porches, three storage rooms, a pool, trees and space to grow your own food. Well water.

rows.title: Fully renovated 227 m² house with a 70 m² patio and barbecue
rows.why_great: A big family house in Alzira, fully renovated with quality finishes over two floors: a spacious living-dining room, a large fully equipped kitchen opening onto a 70 m² patio with barbecue, air conditioning and a terrace. 227 m². Alzira has a train line to Valencia.

rows.title: Forest house with a 45 m² terrace, hot tub and fireplace
rows.why_great: A terraced house surrounded by forest, 500 metres from Sant Pere Sacarrera in Mediona, about an hour from Barcelona: a bright 29 m² dining room with open kitchen and fireplace opening onto a 45 m² terrace with hot tub, 3 bedrooms and a garden. Quiet enough to live in all year.

rows.title: Newly renovated Mediterranean chalet with a home office, sold furnished
rows.why_great: A detached chalet of 124 m² on a 179 m² plot in Sueca, just renovated in a Mediterranean country style and sold furnished: 2 bedrooms, a large office ready for remote work, a multi-purpose room, a whitewashed patio and terrace with garden. Low running costs. Close to the rice fields of the Albufera and the beaches of Sueca.

rows.title: Log-and-stone mountain house among pines, sold furnished
rows.why_great: A charming mountain house in a residential estate 5 minutes from Piera, with public transport nearby: a 23 m² living room with a mezzanine, semi-open kitchen, bathroom and two bedrooms, a 30 m² garage, a porch and a garden among the pines. Sold furnished. About 50 minutes from Barcelona.

rows.title: House in upper Llíria with a pool terrace, panoramic views and a two-car garage
rows.why_great: A house in the upper part of Llíria, 26 km from Valencia, with panoramic views from the top floor, a large terrace with pool, a barbecue and laundry area, and a garage for two cars on the ground floor. 3 bedrooms, 164 m². Llíria has its own metro line to central Valencia.

rows.title: Single-storey country house with pool, garden, barbecue and two outbuildings
rows.why_great: Detached single-storey house on its own fenced plot, 40 minutes from Madrid: front porch, 4 bedrooms, separate living room, kitchen and bathroom. Outside there is a private pool, a garden with olive trees, a covered barbecue and wood oven, and two outbuildings for a garage and storage. 185 m². Public transport to central Madrid.

rows.title: Bright two-storey villa from 1920 a few minutes from Viborg
rows.why_great: 138 m² over two floors on a 792 m² plot in green surroundings, minutes from the cathedral town of Viborg. Classic 1920 charm with a modernised white kitchen, big terrace and three bedrooms; ready to move in. Listed at DKK 695,000. EU citizens who move to Denmark can buy freely; others need permission from the Ministry of Justice.

rows.title: Six-room country villa from 1877 with a heat pump in Hjerm
rows.why_great: 177 m² over two floors with five bedrooms, on a quiet 690 m² plot in Hjerm, West Jutland. Built in 1877 and modernised over the years, most recently with a heat pump that keeps heating cheap. Bright white kitchen, big living room and a covered patio. Listed at DKK 695,000. EU citizens who move to Denmark can buy freely; others need permission from the Ministry of Justice.

rows.title: Character house with panoramic views in Treignac
rows.why_great: A character house of about 88 m² in Treignac, one of the 'most beautiful villages' of the Corrèze, close enough to walk to the shops, with panoramic views over the valley. A 25 m² living room with fireplace and wood stove, two bedrooms under the beams and a modern shower room. No garden to look after.

rows.title: 2012 house with 4 bedrooms, renovated, near the coast in Shizuoka
rows.why_great: Only 14 years old and renovated: a 4-bedroom house of 91.5 m² on a 122 m² plot in Shimizu, Shizuoka, with a fitted kitchen, a new bathroom and a tatami room. A short bus ride to JR Okitsu station on the coast. Asking price ¥14,500,000. That is about €81,900. Foreigners can buy homes in Japan with no restrictions.

rows.title: New 2-bed condo with rooftop and terrace in Mazatlán, ready now
rows.why_great: A 68 m² apartment in La Rocca, a gated complex of eight towers on Av. Delfines in Mazatlán's Alarcón area: living and dining room, two bedrooms with wardrobes, a bathroom, laundry, terrace and parking. Equipped rooftop, sports court, play area and 24-hour access control. Immediate delivery. Asking price MXN 1,772,566. That is about €86,100. Within 50 km of the coast, foreigners buy through a bank trust (fideicomiso).

rows.title: Porch cottage on a big lot next to the park in the Ozarks
rows.why_great: Two bedrooms and one bath in about 81 m² on a 0.65-acre lot in the middle of Oxford, Arkansas. Move-in ready: new flooring and a new water heater, a covered front porch, a carport and a storage shed. The town park is next door and the shops are a walk away. That is about €88,600.

rows.title: Sea-view villa with two covered verandas 1 km from Vignola beach
rows.why_great: An end-of-terrace villa in the Baia Vignola residential complex in north Sardinia, with a splendid sea view: a bright living room with a kitchenette, a master bedroom, a second small bedroom and a shower room, plus two large covered verandas, one facing the sea for lunches and dinners in the breeze, and a private garden. Parking space in the complex. The village of Vignola Mare and its crystal-clear beaches are 1 km away. Asking €160,000, about €1,860/m².

rows.title: Renovated granite stazzo with flower boxes in a Sardinian village
rows.why_great: A traditional Gallurese stazzo in the historic centre of Luras, northern Sardinia, restored with respect for its exposed granite, wood and iron: a living room with an open kitchen around a big fireplace, a reed-and-beam ceiling, bold colours and pop touches, a double bedroom, a second bedroom, two bathrooms and an attic. Flower boxes on the stone façade, and the Costa Smeralda beaches about 40 minutes away. Asking €97,000, about €1,386/m².

rows.title: The historic Savage House: a white Victorian with a gingerbread porch
rows.why_great: Step into the charm of the historic Savage House, a beautiful 1900 Victorian in Scotland Neck, North Carolina: 2,143 sq ft (199 m²) with three bedrooms and two bathrooms, gingerbread trim, a front porch reached by a brick path, high ceilings and freshly finished interiors with wood floors, on a large shaded lot. Asking $169,900 (about €151,000), about €759/m².

rows.title: Summer cottage on a 980 m² garden plot 2 km from the beach
rows.why_great: A 62 m² house on a flat plot of 980 m² among olive trees and just a few neighbours, near Marathopolis: a sitting area with a wood stove, an open kitchen, a bedroom and a shower room downstairs, and a wooden staircase up to an attic with a balcony and extra beds. A garden with paths, a storeroom and a built-in BBQ. 2 km to Lagouvardos beach, 15 minutes to Gialova and its golf courses, 25 to Pylos. Asking €158,000, about €2,548/m².

rows.title: Riverfront house on French Island with views of the Penobscot
rows.why_great: A 1,258 sq ft (117 m²) three-bedroom home on historic French Island in Old Town, Maine, with stunning views of the Penobscot River right from the yard: a standing-seam metal roof, a fresh kitchen, a bright living room and a lot that runs down to the water. Bangor and the University of Maine are minutes away. Asking $185,000 (about €164,400), about €1,405/m².

rows.title: Modern, furnished two-bedroom house near the sea on Rhodes
rows.why_great: An 84 m² detached house in Paradeisi on Rhodes, in very good condition, modern, bright and sold furnished: a stylish kitchen with a breakfast bar and pendant lights, a living room, two bedrooms and a bathroom. Air conditioning, a solar water heater, aluminium frames and tiled floors, with no shared expenses. Close to the sea, shops, cafés and the island's airport. Asking €155,000, about €1,845/m².

rows.title: Gambrel-roof cabin with a wrap porch and fire pit in the Allegheny forest
rows.why_great: 'The best cabin weekends start with: who's coming?' A 1986 gambrel-roof cabin on 0.6 acres in Tionesta, on the edge of the Allegheny National Forest: 1,013 sq ft (94 m²) with a wrap-around porch, a knotty-pine kitchen and dining room, a cosy living room with a gas heater, two bedrooms plus a bunk loft, and a fire pit with benches in the yard. Asking $154,900 (about €137,700), about €1,465/m².

rows.title: Scandinavian-style log cabin with a stone fireplace on 10 acres
rows.why_great: A large custom-built Scandinavian-style log cabin from 1998 on a quiet country road in Saxon, Wisconsin, near Lake Superior: 1,430 sq ft (133 m²) with full log walls, a fieldstone hearth with a wood stove, a breakfast bar, three bedrooms, a log staircase to the loft and a green metal roof, on 10 acres of woods. Asking $179,000 (about €159,100), about €1,196/m².

rows.title: Log cabin at Canadohta Lake with a duck pond out front
rows.why_great: A two-bedroom log cabin at Canadohta Lake in northwest Pennsylvania, with a pond and ducks right in front: about 1,000 sq ft (93 m²) with a wood-panelled living room, a kitchen with granite counters and stainless appliances, a loft, a bathroom with laundry, a wrap-around porch, a picnic area and a green metal roof. A short walk to the lake for boating, swimming and ice fishing. Asking $200,000 (about €177,700), about €1,911/m².

rows.title: Adirondack farmhouse on 10.8 acres of autumn forest
rows.why_great: Forestport Adirondack foothills retreat on 10.8 acres: a 1918 farmhouse of 1,577 sq ft (147 m²) with three bedrooms, a renovated grey kitchen with butcher-block counters, a dining room, a living room with a stone accent wall and an enclosed sun porch, surrounded by maple forest that turns red and gold every October. Asking $179,000 (about €159,100), about €1,082/m².

rows.title: Charming 1952 Cape Cod with fall colours on a 1.1-acre lot
rows.why_great: Charm, space and a great setting: a 1952 three-bedroom Cape Cod on 1.1 acres in LaVale, in the Allegheny Mountains of western Maryland, with 1,868 sq ft (174 m²), hardwood floors, a wooden staircase, bright freshly painted rooms, a full basement and a big lawn framed by trees that blaze orange in autumn. Asking $175,000 (about €155,500), about €894/m².

airport.name: John Murtha Johnstown Cambria County Airport

rows.title: Stone-and-beam Tuscan home with a 70 m² terrace and high-end finishes
rows.why_great: A single-family home free on three sides in Roccastrada, in the Grosseto hills, finished with high-quality materials: exposed stone walls, wooden beam ceilings, oak floors and a big arched window, a spacious living room, a glass-walled kitchen and two bedrooms over two floors. A large terrace of about 70 m² and a big garage. The Tuscan sea is about 40 minutes away. Asking €158,000, about €718/m².

rows.title: Brand-new 2024 log cabin surrounded by farmland in Kentucky
rows.why_great: A beautiful 2024 log cabin on a 1-acre lot surrounded by farmland in Elk Horn, Kentucky: 1,224 sq ft (114 m²) with a cathedral wood ceiling, a sage-green kitchen with a farmhouse sink and stainless appliances, hardwood floors, two bedrooms, a modern tiled bathroom and a covered front porch. The lot is part of a 29-acre tract. Asking $175,000 (about €155,500), about €1,364/m².

rows.title: Cosy mountain townhouse near the Abetone ski slopes, sold furnished
rows.why_great: A 127 m² terraced house free on three sides in the centre of Cutigliano, a few kilometres from the ski slopes of Doganaccia and Abetone: a large beamed living room with a fireplace and parquet, a kitchen with a wood-fired grill, a utility room, three bedrooms and a bathroom, plus a partly usable attic. In very good condition, with efficient systems, and sold furnished. Price negotiable. Asking €159,000, about €1,252/m².

rows.title: Medieval-village house with a terrace above a sea of clouds in Tuscany
rows.why_great: A 148 m² townhouse on four levels in a medieval hamlet of the 'Svizzera Pesciatina', a few kilometres from Pescia: a guest flat with its own entrance, a panoramic room with a fireplace, a kitchen, living room and bedroom, and on top a bedroom, bathroom and a terrace with views over wooded valleys, often filled with morning mist. New heating (LPG, pellet and wood). Lucca, Pisa and Florence are within reach. Asking €150,000, about €1,014/m².

rows.title: Three-bedroom village house with a vine-covered terrace and sea views in Messinia
rows.why_great: A 116 m² two-storey house in Vasilitsi, at the southern tip of the Messinian peninsula, with views over the sea and the hills: three bedrooms, two kitchens, two living rooms and two bathrooms, a covered veranda and a vine-shaded terrace with blue railings, plus a roof terrace with views of the sea and mountains. Air conditioning, double glazing and wooden floors. Memi and Ammoudi beaches are about 3 km away. Asking €109,000, about €940/m².

rows.title: Lake-country home with a wood stove, deck and pool near Big Wolf Lake
rows.why_great: A charming three-bedroom, two-bathroom home on Big Wolf Lake Road in Lewiston, northern Michigan: 1,545 sq ft (144 m²) with a pine-ceiling living room and wood stove, a colourful dining room, a kitchen with stainless appliances, a covered front porch, a deck with an above-ground pool and 0.9 acres of pines. Lakes, trails and golf all around. Asking $195,000 (about €173,300), about €1,203/m².

rows.title: Stylish renovated flat with a fireplace and terrace in Montaione, Tuscany
rows.why_great: A three-room first-floor home with a fully independent entrance in the quiet Mura area of Montaione, carefully renovated in 2019: a spacious living room with a fireplace opening onto a private terrace, a modern kitchen with a wooden table and pendant lights, two bright bedrooms and a bathroom with a window. Below, a private courtyard and a cellar with a laundry corner. In the hills between Florence, Pisa and Siena. Asking €140,000, about €1,795/m².

rows.title: Renovated Umbrian country home with an annexe, vines and an orchard
rows.why_great: A finely renovated 90 m² home over three floors in the small Valdilucciole hamlet near Città della Pieve, plus a 24 m² annexe with a living/sleeping area: beamed ceilings, a living room with a pellet stove, a kitchen, two bathrooms and three bedrooms with countryside views. A fenced garden and orchard with olive, peach, pear, fig and plum trees and a row of table grapes. New roof in 2015 and double-glazed wooden windows. Asking €160,000, about €1,404/m².

airport.name: Perugia San Francesco d'Assisi – Umbria International Airport

rows.title: Stone island house with blue doors and a sea view over to Skiathos
rows.why_great: A 110 m² stone maisonette in Paleo Klima, Glossa, on the Mamma Mia island of Skopelos, with an open, unobstructed view of the Aegean and Skiathos. Bright blue shutters and doors, wooden beamed ceilings, a traditional fireplace corner, a sunny kitchen-living room and two bedrooms over two levels. Close to the main road with easy access, and sold ready to move into. Asking €150,000, about €1,364/m².

rows.title: Furnished Cretan house with a shared pool for just four homes
rows.why_great: Villa Dionysos: a fully furnished 76 m² two-bedroom house over two floors in a small, quiet complex in Drapanos, near Chania. A bright open-plan living room with a corner sofa and fireplace opens onto a covered private terrace; the kitchen and dining area look out over the pool, shared by only four houses and backed by open countryside. Upstairs, two double bedrooms, each with its own terrace, the master with sea views. Asking €158,000, about €2,079/m².

rows.title: Whitewashed Cretan village house with a roof terrace and spiral stairs
rows.why_great: A renovated 93 m² detached house in the traditional village of Choumeriako, 3 km from Neapoli and 13 km from the beaches of Agios Nikolaos. Downstairs, a modern kitchen, two bedrooms and a bathroom with a corner bath; a spiral staircase leads up to a lovely sitting room with a wood stove that opens onto a big terrace with umbrellas and views over the village. Stone arches, wooden beams and whitewashed walls keep its old character. Asking €115,000, about €1,237/m².

rows.title: Hillside house with a sea-view veranda 1 km from Porto Ottiolu beach
rows.why_great: A two-level terraced house in the peaceful hillside hamlet of Ludduì, Budoni, with an exclusive view of the Sardinian sea: a bright living room with an open kitchen and a spiral staircase, opening onto a covered veranda for dining with the sea on the horizon; upstairs, a master bedroom with its own courtyard, a second bedroom and a bathroom. 1 km from the golden beach and marina of Porto Ottiolu and 2.5 km from Budoni. Asking €158,000, about €2,469/m².

rows.title: Tuscan cottage with an olive-tree garden 5 minutes from Saturnia hot springs
rows.why_great: An independent house with a corner garden and a beautiful olive tree in Montemerano, one of the Most Beautiful Villages in Italy, in the hills of the Tuscan Maremma: a living room with a kitchenette, two well-kept bedrooms with spectacular views and a bathroom, plus a 24 m² garage underneath. Panoramic position and its own entrance; the famous Saturnia hot springs are just 5 minutes by car. Price recently reduced. Asking €139,000, about €1,829/m².

airport.name: Perugia San Francesco d'Assisi – Umbria International Airport

rows.title: Brand-new 2025 cottage with a pergola deck 400 m from the sea in Halkidiki
rows.why_great: A new-build 72 m² house from 2025 in Kallikrateia, Halkidiki, energy class A and sold furnished: three bedrooms, a living room, a kitchen and three bathrooms, with a big wooden pergola deck, string lights for summer evenings, a garden with banana plants, parking, A/C, double glazing and a BBQ. The sea is 400 m away and Thessaloniki airport about 45 km. Asking €159,990, about €2,222/m².

rows.title: Well-kept A-frame on 2.5 acres in Michigan's Upper Peninsula
rows.why_great: Just outside Kenton, in the Ottawa National Forest area of Michigan's Upper Peninsula, a well-kept 1984 A-frame on 2.49 acres: 1,097 sq ft (102 m²) with three bedrooms, a kitchen with an island, a vaulted wood-panelled loft, a sunroom looking onto the woods, a deck and a fire pit. Snowmobile and ATV trails start nearby. Asking $160,000 (about €142,200), about €1,394/m².

rows.title: Fairy-tale house with a gazebo and stone BBQ in the Pelion forest
rows.why_great: Surrounded by towering trees in the mountain village of Chania in Pelion, a 68 m² single-family house renovated in 2021 on a 213 m² corner plot: a wood-lined living room with a fireplace, a bedroom with its own fireplace, a modern kitchen, a bathroom and a small veranda, plus a 29 m² basement, two storerooms, a built-in stone BBQ and a large covered gazebo in a green garden. Sold with furniture and three inverter air conditioners. Asking €95,000, about €1,397/m².

rows.title: Wooden island-style house with a BBQ terrace hanging over the Pagasetic Gulf
rows.why_great: In the cobbled, island-like village of Trikeri at the tip of Pelion, a 54 m² house on two levels: a carefully renovated wooden studio with a high ceiling, a loft with a double bed, kitchen, dining area and bathroom, opening onto a big covered terrace with a wood oven, a BBQ and a fantastic view of the sea. Below, a separate 15 m² studio with its own kitchen and shower. Sleeps six; use it as one house or two holiday flats. Asking €120,000, about €2,222/m².

rows.title: Single-storey house with a private pool on a 1,000 m² plot near Seville
rows.why_great: A fully fenced plot of about 1,000 m² in a small, quiet gated residential estate in Los Palacios, right by the AP-4 to Seville. The main house is single-storey and in good condition, with no damp or cracks: a living-dining room with a fireplace and an open fitted kitchen, three bedrooms and a full bathroom, plus a front porch looking onto an 8.2 x 5 m swimming pool in impeccable condition. Also a pump room with a toilet, a double storeroom with a summer kitchen, parking for several cars and an orchard with fruit trees. About 120 m² built as listed. Seville is about 25 minutes away. Asking €145,000, about €1,208/m².
rows.location_name: Urbanización El Cuzco, Los Palacios y Villafranca, Seville (about 25 min from Seville)

rows.title: Premium townhouse fully renovated in 2025 in Jijona
rows.why_great: A 232 m² townhouse just off the main street of Jijona, completely renovated in 2025 to a premium standard and never lived in since: new plumbing and wiring, a replaced roof with a big skylight that floods the staircase with light, PVC double glazing, marble-look porcelain floors and black wrought-iron balconies. Seven split levels: a kitchen-diner with a wine fridge and a storeroom, a living-dining room, four bedrooms and two full bathrooms, one with a freestanding tub. East-facing, steps from the Barranco park, the new library and public parking. Alicante is about 25 minutes by car. Asking €149,000, about €642/m².
rows.location_name: Jijona / Xixona, Alicante (about 25 min from Alicante)

rows.title: Remodelled three-bedroom penthouse with a 40 m² private roof terrace in Santomera
rows.why_great: A bright 2005 penthouse in the centre of Santomera, fully remodelled and furnished in 2014 with top-quality furniture and appliances: 105 m² with a living room, a modern kitchen, a laundry, three bedrooms with fitted wardrobes and two full bathrooms, plus a 40 m² private roof terrace with a built-in barbecue and sink and a 27 m² enclosed room with its own air conditioning and toilet. Central ducted air conditioning with heat pump, floating floors throughout, a lift and an 11 m² garage space. Move-in ready, with shops two minutes' walk away; Murcia is about 15 minutes by car. Asking €145,000, about €1,000/m².
rows.location_name: Central Santomera, Murcia (about 15 min from Murcia)

rows.title: Five-bedroom village house in move-in condition with a roof terrace and solar panels
rows.why_great: A roomy 180 m² townhouse in the very heart of Hondón de los Frailes, steps from shops, bars and services, in excellent move-in condition: a modern living room with a wood-burning fireplace, a fitted kitchen with a dining area, five bedrooms and two bathrooms. Central heating, air conditioning, solar panels and a private roof terrace / solarium with village and mountain views, plus a patio of about 60 m². Ideal for a big family or to mix own use with holiday letting. Elche is about 25 minutes by car. Asking €149,950, about €833/m².
rows.location_name: Hondón de los Frailes, Alicante (about 25 min from Elche)

rows.title: Never-lived-in ground-floor flat with a communal pool in Albatera
rows.why_great: A spacious 139 m² ground-floor flat in a modern 2006 building in a quiet part of Albatera, never lived in and fully step-free with a ramp at the entrance: three large bedrooms, two full bathrooms (one en suite), a bright living-dining room opening onto a balcony, and a fully equipped kitchen with its own access to the balcony. Wooden floors, ducted air conditioning already installed and a parking space with direct access from the garage to the flat. Communal pool with a lawn. Supermarkets, shops and schools are close by; Elche is about 22 minutes away. Asking €135,000, about €971/m².

rows.title: Fully renovated three-bedroom house with an 80 m² roof terrace in Alzira
rows.why_great: A 113 m² house in the Alquerieta area of Alzira, fully renovated from the wiring and plumbing to the floors, doors, windows, kitchen and bathrooms. Downstairs, a large living-dining room open to a smart white kitchen with access to a big patio with a laundry area, plus a full bathroom; upstairs, three good bedrooms and a second bathroom with a glass shower. On top, a private roof terrace of about 80 m². Marble-look floors and a bright modern finish throughout. Valencia is about 35 minutes by car. Asking €91,000, about €805/m².
rows.location_name: Alquerieta, Alzira, Valencia (about 35 min from Valencia)

rows.title: Spacious 150 m² three-bedroom flat with a lift and parking in Bigastro
rows.why_great: A generous 150 m² flat in the heart of Bigastro, close to shops, schools and green areas: a living room opening onto a balcony, a separate dining area, a modern dark-wood kitchen with gas hob and built-in oven, three large bedrooms with fitted wardrobes and two full bathrooms, one en suite with a bathtub. Air conditioning, a laundry, a lift and a parking space. Well kept and ready to move into. Orihuela is next door and Murcia about 25 minutes away. Asking €145,000, about €967/m².
rows.location_name: Central Bigastro, Alicante (about 25 min from Murcia)

rows.title: Three-bedroom flat with a full high-spec renovation in Utrera
rows.why_great: A 102 m² flat in the El Tinte area of Utrera, renovated throughout with high-quality materials: new wiring and plumbing, marble-look floors, recessed lighting, a modern kitchen with built-in oven and microwave, a bright living room, three bedrooms with fitted wardrobes and a stylish bathroom, plus a laundry area. Nothing to do but move in. Seville is about 25 minutes by car or train. Asking €80,000, about €784/m².
rows.location_name: El Tinte, Utrera, Seville (about 25 min from Seville)

rows.title: Ground-floor home with terraces and a communal pool on the Condado de Alhama golf resort
rows.why_great: A 106 m² ground-floor home in the quiet gated Condado de Alhama resort, next to the golf course: a bright living room with an open, fully fitted kitchen, two double bedrooms and a single, a bathroom, and two private terraces with a pergola and a small garden. Sold furnished and in move-in condition, with air conditioning, a private parking space, a communal pool set in palm gardens and children's play areas. East-facing for light all day. Murcia and Cartagena are each about 35 minutes away. Asking €129,000, about €1,217/m².
rows.location_name: Condado de Alhama, Alhama de Murcia (about 35 min from Murcia and Cartagena)

rows.title: Move-in ready three-bedroom ground-floor home with its own entrance in San Isidro
rows.why_great: A ground-floor home in San Isidro with its own independent entrance, ready to enjoy from day one: 96 m² usable (152 m² built as listed) with a large living-dining room, a long fitted kitchen, three bedrooms and two bathrooms, plus a terrace with planters, a laundry, a storeroom and a garage parking space. Sold furnished, with air conditioning and heating. No painters and no renovation budget needed. Elche is about 16 minutes away. Asking €144,997, about €954/m².
rows.location_name: San Isidro, Alicante (about 16 min from Elche)

rows.title: Brand-new four-bedroom flat of 135 m² in Agualada, Galicia
rows.why_great: A brand-new, never-lived-in 135 m² flat (117 m² usable) on the first floor in Agualada, Coristanco: a 29 m² open-plan kitchen, dining and living space with a breakfast bar and fitted appliances, four generous bedrooms (18.9, 16.5, 16.3 and 12 m²), a 9 m² shower room and a storeroom. Double-glazed aluminium windows, laminate floors and an electric water heater; no lift. 1.3 km from the motorway; Carballo is 12 km away and A Coruña about 35 minutes by car. Asking €116,900, about €866/m².
rows.location_name: Agualada, Coristanco, A Coruña (about 35 min from A Coruña)

rows.title: Fully renovated stone house with beams and a fireplace near Valladolid
rows.why_great: A characterful 124 m² house with thick stone walls in the village of Velliza, about 20 km from Valladolid. Completely renovated, including floors, doors, bathrooms and windows, with exposed beams and stone throughout. Downstairs, a large living-dining room with a fireplace, an office-style kitchen, a bathroom and direct access to the garage; upstairs, a spacious sitting room now used as a bedroom, two more bedrooms and a full bathroom. New pellet-stove heating plus electric radiators. No garden or patio. Valladolid is about 25 minutes by car. Asking €138,000, about €1,113/m².

rows.title: Fully renovated three-bedroom townhouse with a two-car garage in Colomera
rows.why_great: A 228 m² townhouse in the Barrio Alto of Colomera, renovated top to bottom with a sleek white finish: an open, fully fitted kitchen flowing into a large living-dining room, a bathroom and a laundry area downstairs, and a small patio garden off the living room. Upstairs, three bright bedrooms and a full bathroom; on the top floor, a big extra room for a studio, playroom or fourth bedroom, plus a rooftop terrace with a pergola. Garage for two cars and heat-pump air conditioning. Move-in ready; Granada is about 35 minutes away. Asking €119,000, about €522/m².
rows.location_name: Barrio Alto, Colomera, Granada (about 35 min from Granada)

rows.title: Family townhouse with a garden and a glass room in Eslöv
rows.why_great: A 117 m² townhouse on two floors in a well-run, car-free association in Eslöv: a living room opening onto the garden, a kitchen with an island, a utility room, a shower room and a bedroom downstairs; two more bedrooms, a landing and a second bathroom upstairs. A south-facing deck at the front, a hedged garden with another deck and a glass room at the back. Built in 1988 and well kept. Swedish co-op (bostadsrätt) with a monthly fee of 9,303 SEK (about €830). Asking 1,050,000 SEK (about €94,100), about €804/m².

rows.title: Three-bedroom brick townhouse with a garden near the south coast in Skivarp
rows.why_great: A 102 m² 1950s brick townhouse on a quiet, leafy cul-de-sac in the village of Skivarp: generous ceiling heights, stone stairs, a living room with a tiled stove, a dining kitchen and three good bedrooms, plus a sunny glazed garden room and a private garden plot. District heating. A few kilometres from the beaches at Mossbystrand and Abbekås. Swedish co-op (bostadsrätt) with a monthly fee of 5,700 SEK (about €510). Asking 695,000 SEK (about €62,300), about €611/m².
rows.location_name: Skivarp, Skurup, Skåne (about 60 min from Copenhagen)

rows.title: Stylish three-bedroom flat with a 2023 kitchen in central Eslöv
rows.why_great: A 90.5 m² ground-floor through-flat in the middle of Eslöv: a bright hall, a large living room, three bedrooms (one opening onto a balcony over a quiet courtyard), a sleek 2023 kitchen with room for a dining table and a fully tiled bathroom, plus an attic storeroom. Walking distance to Eslöv station, with trains to Lund, Malmö and Copenhagen. Swedish co-op flat (bostadsrätt) with a monthly fee of 9,399 SEK (about €840). Asking 1,095,000 SEK (about €98,100), about €1,090/m².
rows.location_name: Central Eslöv, Skåne (about 55 min from Copenhagen)

rows.title: Thatched half-timbered village house opposite the church in Ørslev
rows.why_great: A storybook 91 m² village house with half-timbering, a thatched roof and small-paned windows, right opposite the church in Ørslev near Ringsted. Older but fully usable condition, with a cheerful farmhouse kitchen, a dining room and living rooms; district heating. Also a 42 m² outbuilding in the same style, a 15 m² annexe and an easy garden. The village has a shop, a nursery and sports clubs; Copenhagen is about 50 minutes by car. Asking 645,000 DKK (about €86,300), about €948/m².
rows.location_name: Ørslev, near Ringsted (about 50 min from Copenhagen)

rows.title: Bright 1929 flat with three bedrooms near the centre of Landskrona
rows.why_great: A 110 m² second-floor flat from 1929 a stone's throw from the centre of Landskrona: a large hall, three proper bedrooms, a big living room with a bay window, a modern kitchen and a fully tiled shower room with washer-dryer, plus two storerooms and a stairwell balcony over a leafy courtyard. High ceilings, parquet and big windows, in move-in condition. It is a Swedish co-op flat (bostadsrätt) with a monthly fee of 9,665 SEK (about €870). Trains reach Copenhagen in about 50 minutes. Asking 1,095,000 SEK (about €98,100), about €892/m².

rows.title: Through-flat with three bedrooms and a sunny balcony in Malmö
rows.why_great: An 84 m² through-flat on the 6th floor with a lift and open views over the area: a spacious living and dining room, three good bedrooms, a fresh kitchen, two toilets and a big sunny balcony. Light floors and bright white rooms, ready to move into. Swedish co-op flat (bostadsrätt) with a monthly fee of 7,586 SEK (about €680). Copenhagen is about 40 minutes by car over the Øresund bridge. Asking 750,000 SEK (about €67,200), about €800/m².

rows.title: Bright 130 m² villa with a big garden in Døjringe, Mid-Zealand
rows.why_great: A 130 m² villa in the small village of Døjringe near Sorø: light living rooms with lots of windows, a simple white kitchen, a study corner with garden views, a roomy entrance hall and a large garden with fruit trees, vegetable beds and a greenhouse.
