Lived in and ready to use, with room to make it your own. Sorø lake and the motorway to Copenhagen are close by. Asking 695,000 DKK (about €93,000), about €715/m².
rows.location_name: Døjringe, Munke Bjergby (about 60 min from Copenhagen)

rows.title: Renovated stone house with a Libyan Sea view in Agios Vasileios, Crete
rows.why_great: A 61 m² stone house in the village of Agios Vasileios (Viannos), renovated in 2010, with a sweeping view over olive groves to the Libyan Sea from its terraces. An open living room and kitchen under wooden beams, two bedrooms, a bathroom and a small storeroom in the yard, on a 148 m² plot with parking outside. Sold furnished. Energy rating D. Asking €76,000, about €1,246/m².

rows.title: Two-level stone house with a sea view in Marathokampos, Samos
rows.why_great: A well-kept 80 m² stone house in the upper part of Marathokampos, in the Agia Triada area, with a wonderful view of the sea. On the ground floor a kitchen, a dining room and a bathroom; upstairs two bedrooms, a living room, a hall and a WC. Wooden window frames, parquet and tiled floors and a wood boiler for heating. A traditional house in a picturesque spot, ready to live in. Asking €68,000, about €850/m².

rows.title: Furnished two-bedroom flat with a sea view in Pefki, North Evia
rows.why_great: A 50 m² first-floor flat a few hundred metres from the beach in Pefki, on the island of Evia, with a sea view from the balcony. Two bedrooms, a fitted kitchen, a modern shower room and a dining corner, all freshly finished with light floors. Electric heating, air conditioning, a security door and parking. Sold fully furnished and equipped, ready to use or rent out. Energy rating E. Asking €80,000, about €1,600/m².

rows.title: Renovated stone house with a sea view in Marathokampos, Samos
rows.why_great: A renovated two-storey stone house in the Profitis Ilias quarter of Marathokampos, high above the bay, with a wide sea view from the balcony and windows. Downstairs a living room, a kitchen and a bathroom open onto a small courtyard; upstairs two bright bedrooms. Double glazing and air conditioning; sold furnished and with appliances, ready to move into. Energy rating F. Asking €80,000, about €1,250/m².

rows.title: Village house with a panoramic sea-and-mountain terrace in Rossell, Castellón
rows.why_great: A 120 m² village house in picturesque Rossell with sweeping views: an entrance hall, a sitting room, a kitchen, five bedrooms, a bathroom and two terraces, one of them with a panoramic view over the sea and the mountains. In the heart of the village with services at hand, at the foot of the Ports de Tortosa-Beseit natural park and about 20 minutes from the coast. Recently reduced from €60,000. Asking €55,000, about €458/m².

rows.title: Ready-to-move-in two-bedroom flat with a sea-view terrace in Kavarna
rows.why_great: An 86.5 m² flat on the ground floor of a well-maintained 2007 complex, a 3-minute walk from the beach: an entrance hall, a living room with a fully fitted kitchen and dining area, two furnished bedrooms, a bathroom and a terrace with sea views. South-west exposure brings light all day. Sold fully furnished and equipped, in very good condition with no renovation needed; suits holidays or year-round living. Asking €66,000, about €759/m².

rows.title: Two-bedroom flat with two sea-panorama terraces in Kavarna Hills
rows.why_great: A furnished 99.6 m² flat on the fourth of six floors in a 2008 brick building in the Kavarna Hills complex, in the seaside part of town: an entrance hall, a big living-dining room with a kitchenette, two bedrooms, two bathrooms and two terraces with a lovely sea panorama over the pools and Cape Chirakman. Lift, parking space and two outdoor pools; the sea is three minutes away. Asking €69,000, about €690/m².

rows.title: Furnished two-bedroom flat with a sea view in a gated complex in Kavarna
rows.why_great: A spacious 89.5 m² flat on the third floor of a five-storey building in the well-kept gated complex Kavarna Paradise, a 3-minute walk from the beach: an entrance hall, a living room with a kitchenette, two bedrooms, a bathroom and two terraces. South-west facing, bright, with a pleasant sea view. Fully furnished and ready to use with no renovation needed; cable TV and internet. The complex has a pool. Asking €66,000, about €733/m².

rows.title: Furnished two-bedroom flat with a sea-view terrace 300 m from the beach in Kavarna
rows.why_great: A 99 m² flat on the fifth of six floors, about 300 m from the beach: a hallway, a spacious living room with a kitchen, two fully equipped bathrooms, two bedrooms, a cellar and two terraces, one with a sea view. Sold with all furniture and appliances (air conditioning, oven, hob, washing machine, fridge), ready to rent out or move in. The complex has two outdoor pools, parking and a play area; maintenance fee €750 a year. Asking €70,000, about €707/m².

rows.title: Fully renovated Alpujarra village house with a sea-view terrace in Murtas
rows.why_great: A charming village house from 1900, fully renovated with a brand-new roof, keeping its Alpujarra character: chestnut beams, a fireplace and original Granada tiles. Downstairs a cosy living room and the kitchen; upstairs two bedrooms, a bathroom and a new south-facing open terrace with views to the Mediterranean on clear days and to the Sierra de Gádor. Electric heating, wooden window frames and terrazzo floors. It overlooks the village park, La Fuentecilla. Asking €49,000, about €570/m².

rows.title: Bright top-floor flat with a sea-view balcony in Corme Porto, Costa da Morte
rows.why_great: A well-kept three-bedroom flat in the centre of Corme, one of the prettiest fishing villages on the Costa da Morte: a separate kitchen, a pantry, a laundry area, a living room opening onto a wide balcony with sea views and a renovated bathroom. Top (fourth) floor with no neighbours above, so it is quiet. The 1980s building has a renovated facade and common areas. Shops, a pharmacy and cafés are downstairs and the seafront promenade is a few metres away. Sold furnished. Asking €68,500, about €856/m².

rows.title: Sunny three-bedroom flat with sea and mountain views in Cariño
rows.why_great: A roomy 92 m² furnished flat in the middle of Cariño, about 180 m from the beach and promenade: a hallway with a built-in wardrobe, a large kitchen, a living-dining room with a fireplace and a balcony looking at the sea and the mountains, three bedrooms and two shower rooms. Every room is exterior. New PVC double-glazed windows, solid wooden doors and tiled floors. Third floor with no lift; everything you need is on the flat within walking distance. Asking €65,000, about €707/m².

rows.title: Two-bedroom flat with a panoramic sea view on the first line in Pomorie
rows.why_great: An 81 m² flat on the second floor of Sunset Resort in Pomorie, right on the first line by a soft sandy beach, with a panoramic sea view: two bedrooms, a living room with a kitchenette, a walk-in wardrobe, a bathroom and a terrace. Fully furnished and equipped. The resort has four outdoor pools, an indoor pool, a lazy river, children's slides, bars and restaurants. Asking €59,900, about €740/m².

rows.title: Renovated three-level house with an energy rating C in Decazeville, Aveyron
rows.why_great: A neat, renovated townhouse: a cellar, a laundry and an entrance on the ground floor; a bright living room with an open kitchen, a bedroom and a WC on the first floor; more bedrooms, a modern shower room, a separate WC and a study on the second. Laminate floors, white walls and energy rating C, so low running costs. Figeac and the Lot valley are close. Seller pays the agency fee. Asking €49,980, about €431/m².

rows.title: 171 m² house with a former shop in the centre of Bussière-Poitevine
rows.why_great: In the heart of the village, next to the baker, pharmacy and school: a cellar, a kitchen, a living room, a WC and a former shop with a street window on the ground floor; two bedrooms and two shower rooms on the first floor; and a near-independent top floor with its own kitchen, living room, bedroom and shower room. Room for a family, a business with living space or a holiday let. On the Limoges–Poitiers road. Asking €39,950, about €234/m².

rows.title: Country house with a veranda near the Saint-Rémy lake, Thiers
rows.why_great: In a quiet hamlet 5 km from Thiers and the Saint-Rémy-sur-Durolle lake: a bright veranda, an open kitchen onto a living room with a fireplace insert; two bedrooms, a study, a bathroom and a WC on the first floor; a spacious third bedroom and an attic on the second. Electric heating; energy rating G (about €2,400–3,300 a year). Seller pays the agency fee. Asking €49,900, about €416/m².

rows.title: Freshly painted three-bedroom village house near the Sabor lakes

rows.title: 93 m² four-room flat with a 13.5 m² balcony by Nelson Mandela Park

rows.title: Four-room flat with energy label A and a south balcony in Zuidoost

rows.title: Bright south-west three-room flat with a lift in Le Havre

rows.title: Recently renovated through flat with a heat pump in Saint-Étienne

rows.title: Renovated two-room flat for €39,000 in Saint-Étienne

rows.title: Three-room flat with a modern kitchen and two balconies in Reigersbos

rows.title: Renovated one-bedroom flat in central Roubaix, near Lille

rows.title: Top-floor flat under the eaves with skylights near the Gaasperplas

rows.title: Renovated studio with a balcony by the Bagatelle metro, Toulouse

rows.title: Top-floor four-room flat with energy label A and green views, Gein

Asking €305,000 k.k. (buyer pays transfer costs), about €4,357/m².

rows.title: Three-room flat with a sunny roof terrace by Reigersbos market

rows.title: Town house with a mezzanine in historic Saint-Mathieu, Perpignan

rows.title: Top-floor corner flat with three bedrooms in Venserpolder

rows.title: Four-room 71 m² flat with two balconies in Mulhouse

rows.title: Remodelled corner flat with a south balcony over the canal, Reigersbos

rows.title: 79 m² flat with an 11 m² balcony and open views in Amsterdam-Noord

rows.title: Three-room flat with a 15 m² south balcony and free views in Nellestein

rows.title: Three-room flat with energy label A and a south balcony over the water

rows.title: Furnished four-room flat with a 2020 bathroom in Koło

Furnished, clean and bright, in an insulated block. Asking 349,000 zł (about €79,740). At about €1,379/m² it is in line with the median asking price for flats in Koło.

rows.title: Four-room flat with a lift and dual aspect in Ostrowiec Świętokrzyski
rows.why_great: 68.7 m² on the 2nd floor of a tower block with a lift on Osiedle Ogrody: four rooms, a large hall for built-in wardrobes, PVC windows, east-west light. Liveable as it is, with a 1990s-style kitchen you may want to update later. Asking 339,000 zł (about €77,455). At about €1,127/m² it is roughly 3% below the median asking price for flats in Ostrowiec Świętokrzyski (5,081 zł/m², Morizon sample, October 2026).

rows.title: Sunny four-room flat in central Suwałki
rows.why_great: 58 m² on Waryńskiego street: four rooms, a separate kitchen, a bathroom, a balcony and a cellar. Dual-aspect and very sunny, liveable straight away; the kitchen and bathroom work fine and can be updated later to your taste. Asking 315,000 zł (about €71,971). At about €1,244/m² it is roughly 17% below the median asking price for flats in Suwałki (6,583 zł/m², Morizon sample, October 2026).

rows.title: Four-room flat with a balcony in an insulated block in Bielsk Podlaski
rows.why_great: 62 m² on the 4th floor: a living room with a balcony, three separate rooms, a fully fitted kitchen and a shower room, plus a cellar. Dual-aspect and bright, in a building with new insulation. Service charge about 507 zł a month. Asking 295,000 zł (about €67,402). At about €1,084/m² it is roughly 14% below the median asking price for flats in Bielsk Podlaski (5,521 zł/m², Morizon sample, October 2026).

rows.title: Fully renovated four rooms with 3.3 m ceilings in central Łódź
rows.why_great: 46.7 m² on the 3rd floor of a well-kept 1910 townhouse in Polesie: three separate rooms, a dining room, a new kitchen and a modern bathroom with a walk-in shower. Full renovation, high ceilings, 8 km from Łódź airport. Some photos are virtual staging. Asking 339,000 zł (about €77,455). At about €1,657/m² it is roughly 9% below the median asking price for flats in Łódź (8,011 zł/m², Morizon sample, October 2026).

rows.title: Four-room flat with a balcony and air conditioning in Radomsko
rows.why_great: 57.9 m² on the 3rd floor of Piastowska 25, in a quiet, well-kept estate: a bright living room with a balcony, three more rooms, a kitchen with air conditioning and a bathroom. Liveable now; the price was recently cut to 299,000 zł. Asking 299,000 zł (about €68,316). At about €1,181/m² it is roughly 25% below the median asking price for flats in Radomsko (6,935 zł/m², Morizon sample, October 2026).

rows.title: Sunny four-room flat with a balcony near the lakes in Wałcz
rows.why_great: 57.5 m² on the 1st floor of Królowej Jadwigi 12: four rooms, a kitchen, a bathroom, a separate WC, a balcony and a cellar, with east-west windows. Furnished in an older style but in good order. Wałcz sits between several lakes. Asking 320,000 zł (about €73,114). At about €1,272/m² it is about 15% above the median for flats in Wałcz (4,846 zł/m²), the price of its condition.

rows.title: Four-room flat with open kitchen and city views in Wałbrzych
rows.why_great: 57 m² on the 6th of 10 floors, with a lift: an open kitchen and living room, three bedrooms and a renovated bathroom. The agent describes it as needing no spending and ready to move in now. Asking 349,000 zł (about €79,740). At about €1,399/m² it is about 18% above the median for flats in Wałbrzych (5,207 zł/m²), the price of its condition.

rows.title: Four-room flat with a cellar on a quiet estate in Jarocin
rows.why_great: 62 m² on the top (4th) floor: four rooms, a separate kitchen, bathroom and WC, plus a cellar. The agent lists it as ready to move in, and the price is open to negotiation. Asking 319,000 zł (about €72,885). At about €1,168/m² it is roughly 3% below the median asking price for flats in Jarocin (5,270 zł/m², Morizon sample, October 2026).

rows.title: Four-room flat with a balcony and lift in Gniezno
rows.why_great: 63 m² on the 4th floor of a building with a lift on Osiedle Piastowskie: four rooms, a separate bright kitchen, bathroom, WC and a balcony. Laminate floors and tiles throughout, ready to live in. Asking 330,000 zł (about €75,398). At about €1,197/m² it is roughly 29% below the median asking price for flats in Gniezno (7,384 zł/m², Morizon sample, October 2026).

rows.title: Newly finished 75 m² flat on the main square of Dębica
rows.why_great: 75 m² on the 4th floor of a townhouse on the Główny Rynek: three bedrooms (12, 16 and 9 m²), a 32 m² living room with open kitchen, a walk-in wardrobe and a new marble-look bathroom. There is also an attic that could become extra living space. Asking 350,000 zł (about €79,968). At about €1,066/m² it is roughly 31% below the median asking price for flats in Dębica (6,732 zł/m², Morizon sample, October 2026).

rows.title: Brand-new renovation, four rooms with a view over Brodnica
rows.why_great: 57 m² on the 4th floor, fully renovated this year with all installations replaced, so it is like a new flat: four rooms, a bright kitchen and a new shower room. Views over Brodnica, close to schools and shops; the service charge includes heating and water. Asking 295,000 zł (about €67,402). At about €1,182/m² it is roughly 20% below the median asking price for flats in Brodnica (6,500 zł/m², Morizon sample, October 2026).

rows.title: Bright pre-war flat with three bedrooms and a garden in Boguszów-Gorce
rows.why_great: 69.6 m² on the ground floor of a pre-war townhouse: a living room, three bedrooms, a separate white kitchen and a bathroom. Very well kept and ready to move in, with energy-saving infrared heating and a leased garden you can keep. Asking 330,000 zł (about €75,398). At about €1,083/m² it is about 28% above the median for flats in Boguszów-Gorce (3,697 zł/m²), the price of its condition.

rows.title: Five-room flat in a 1904 building next to the medical university in Zabrze
rows.why_great: 77 m² in the centre of Zabrze, on Plac Dworcowy by the train and bus stations: five separate rooms, a new white kitchen, bathroom. Bright, freshly painted and furnished, the buyer pays no agent fee. Asking 299,000 zł (about €68,316). At about €887/m² it is roughly 33% below the median asking price for flats in Zabrze (5,785 zł/m², Morizon sample, October 2026).

rows.title: Character flat in a 1930s brick townhouse in central Hajnówka
rows.why_great: 62 m² official plus about 15 m² under the sloped ceilings on the top floor: four rooms, a kitchen, a bathroom and a large hall, with solid wood floors and old doors. On the edge of the Białowieża Forest; no neighbours above. Asking 330,000 zł (about €75,398). At about €979/m² it is roughly 34% below the median asking price for flats in Hajnówka (6,474 zł/m², Morizon sample, October 2026).

rows.title: Fully renovated flat with a fireplace and three bedrooms in Lubsko
rows.why_great: 67 m² on the second floor, after a full renovation: a bright living room with a fireplace, three separate bedrooms, kitchen and bathroom. Gas heating, partly furnished, with a cellar, attic and storerooms. The agent says it needs no further spending. Asking 329,000 zł (about €75,170). At about €1,114/m² it is about 22% above the median for flats in Lubsko (4,010 zł/m²), the price of its condition.

rows.title: Designer attic flat with wooden beams and air conditioning in Bytom
rows.why_great: 74 m² under the roof of a townhouse in central Bytom, behind a gated courtyard: an open living room and kitchen, bedrooms, a black-tiled bathroom and original wooden beams. Sold fully furnished with air conditioning; the roof was redone two years ago. Asking 299,000 zł (about €68,316). At about €921/m² it is roughly 16% below the median asking price for flats in Bytom (4,783 zł/m², Morizon sample, October 2026).

rows.title: 127 m² four-room flat with a loggia and pantry in Bytom
rows.why_great: A huge 127 m² flat on the second floor on Falista street: a big living and dining room, three separate bedrooms, a fully fitted kitchen opening onto a loggia, and a pantry. Wood floors and a tiled bathroom with a corner bath, ready to move in. Asking 250,000 zł (about €57,120). At about €448/m² it is roughly 59% below the median asking price for flats in Bytom (4,783 zł/m², Morizon sample, October 2026).

rows.title: Hilltop village house with a sunny terrace in Bourmont
rows.why_great: On the heights of the historic village of Bourmont, in Haute-Marne: a fitted kitchen, a large living room with a fireplace, a balcony and a big fenced south-east terrace, two large bedrooms, an office and a dressing room, plus a garage.

rows.title: Cosy, fully kept village house below the Montagne Noire
rows.why_great: A charming village house of about 50 m² in Saint-Denis, Aude, at the foot of the Montagne Noire north of Carcassonne. Fully maintained: open kitchen and living room, a modern walk-in shower room and two bedrooms under the beams.

rows.title: Yellow village house with a courtyard garden on Funen for €60k
rows.why_great: An 81 m² house kept by the same owner for over 40 years, in the heart of Flemløse on Funen, with a good basement, garage and a sheltered courtyard garden. Ready to move in. Listed at DKK 445,000. EU citizens who move to Denmark can buy freely; others need permission from the Ministry of Justice.

rows.title: Single-storey villa with roof from 2021 and new facades
rows.why_great: 129 m² on one floor in Gjerlev near Randers, renovated inside since 2008, with a new roof in 2021 and fully renovated facades in 2023. New terraces, big 935 m² plot and four bedrooms. Listed at DKK 598,000. EU citizens who move to Denmark can buy freely; others need permission from the Ministry of Justice.

rows.title: Thatched island cottage, ready to move in, on Strynø
rows.why_great: A thatched cottage on Strynø, a tiny island in the South Funen archipelago. 93 m² with a newer kitchen, a newer bathroom, utility room and two bedrooms downstairs plus the first floor. Renovated as it went and ready to move in. Listed at DKK 695,000. EU citizens who move to Denmark can buy freely; others need permission from the Ministry of Justice.

rows.title: Thatched half-timbered house from 1847 in the middle of Funen
rows.why_great: The classic Funen idyll: a thatched, half-timbered house from 1847 near Ringe with exposed beams, a wood stove and 130 m² on an 815 m² garden plot. Renovated over the years and ready to move in, with a greenhouse in the garden. Listed at DKK 695,000. EU citizens who move to Denmark can buy freely; others need permission from the Ministry of Justice.

rows.title: Gambrel-roof farmhouse with metal roof and heat pump in Maine
rows.why_great: Three bedrooms and two bathrooms in about 96 m², with hardwood floors, an eat-in kitchen and updated bathrooms. The big jobs are done: metal roof and an efficient heat pump. Green lot in Ashland, in the woods and lakes of northern Maine. That is about €89,000.

rows.title: Bright refreshed 3-bed with new kitchen next to the national forest
rows.why_great: A two-storey 1910 house of about 108 m², refreshed with a bright neutral interior, new flooring throughout and a kitchen with brand-new appliances. Covered wood deck off the kitchen, three bedrooms upstairs. Kane is the gateway to the Allegheny National Forest. That is about €80,100.

rows.title: Two-bed village house with terrace in Portugal's Dão wine country
rows.why_great: A T2 house with a terrace in Sobral, Carregal do Sal, in the Dão wine region: kitchen, living room, two bedrooms and a bathroom on the main floor, plus large storage rooms on the ground floor; about 134 m² over several levels. A home, a holiday house or a rental.

rows.title: Big family house with sea views over the Strait of Canso
rows.why_great: A well-kept 1949 house in Mulgrave, Nova Scotia, with three bedrooms, 1.5 baths and beautiful views over the Strait of Canso. Updated kitchen, 200-amp electrics and new plumbing; about 215 m² in total. Asking price CAD 144,500. That is about €90,400. Canada's ban on foreign buyers applies in cities and towns of 10,000+ people until 1 January 2027; ask the agent whether it applies here.

rows.title: 2-bed, 2-bath apartment with pool in a gated Mazatlán complex
rows.why_great: A 65 m² apartment in Adora Residencial, a private gated community in Mazatlán: two bedrooms, two bathrooms and covered parking, with a pool, barbecue area, gardens and 24-hour security. In excellent condition. Asking price MXN 1,999,000. That is about €97,100. Within 50 km of the coast, foreigners buy through a bank trust (fideicomiso).

rows.title: Small cortijo with 7,000 m² of almond trees in the Alpujarra
rows.why_great: A detached two-bedroom cortijo of about 60 m² on the edge of Mecina Bombarón, a white village in the high Alpujarra, with around 7,000 m² of land planted with almond trees and open views along the valley. Reached by a concrete road and a short dirt track.

rows.title: Traditional corner house in Agiasos, Lesbos' mountain village
rows.why_great: A traditional corner residence with two bedrooms in Agiasos, at about 460 m on the green slopes of Mount Olympus on Lesbos, a village known for pottery and woodcarving. Freshly painted facade with balcony, stone and wood details inside, and the island's beaches and olive groves around it.

rows.title: Stone town house with three bedrooms and a modern shower
rows.why_great: A stone house in the heart of Auzances, in the green Creuse countryside: a bright living room with a fitted kitchen, three bedrooms, a modern bathroom with a walk-in shower and a basement with a laundry.

rows.title: Easy-living garden townhouse in quiet Herborg
rows.why_great: A well-kept 79 m² terraced house from 1979, modernised and ready to move in, in a quiet neighbourhood of Herborg near Videbæk. Lush garden, bright open kitchen and low upkeep. Listed at DKK 665,000. EU citizens who move to Denmark can buy freely; others need permission from the Ministry of Justice.

rows.title: Black-timber villa with a covered deck, walk to town
rows.why_great: A very well-kept 84 m² villa from 1962 on an 800 m² plot on a quiet street in Brovst, a short walk from the town centre. Modern open kitchen, covered terrace and a big lawn. Listed at DKK 710,000. EU citizens who move to Denmark can buy freely; others need permission from the Ministry of Justice.

rows.title: Villa among rolling hills near the beach at Øster Hurup
rows.why_great: A cosy 136 m² villa from 1981 with four bedrooms in Skelund, a short drive from the sandy beach and holiday town of Øster Hurup. Rolling countryside and the Korup stream around it, with a village café and tennis club in town. Listed at DKK 599,000. EU citizens who move to Denmark can buy freely; others need permission from the Ministry of Justice.

rows.title: Skagen-yellow 1877 house with energy label A
rows.why_great: A lovingly kept house in classic Skagen yellow with white trim and a red tile roof, built in 1877 and now rated A2010: heating costs about DKK 5,400 a year. 124 m² on a 740 m² plot near Fjerritslev, a short drive from the North Sea beaches. Listed at DKK 745,000. EU citizens who move to Denmark can buy freely; others need permission from the Ministry of Justice.

rows.title: Town house a few minutes' walk from the harbour and beach
rows.why_great: A modernised 100 m² town house on a quiet street in Asaa, a few minutes on foot from the harbour and the beach on the Kattegat. Two floors, bay-window living room and three bedrooms, with the shops in walking distance. Listed at DKK 548,000. EU citizens who move to Denmark can buy freely; others need permission from the Ministry of Justice.

rows.title: Old railway house in the forest on a 2,080 m² plot
rows.why_great: The old railway house just north of Tylstrup: 70 m² beautifully modernised, with a bedroom under the roof beams, surrounded by trees on a 2,080 m² plot. Pure peace and quiet, 20 minutes from Aalborg. Listed at DKK 599,000. EU citizens who move to Denmark can buy freely; others need permission from the Ministry of Justice.

rows.title: Modernised villa at the end of a quiet lane, new windows 2026
rows.why_great: 115 m² with three bedrooms on a 750 m² plot at the end of a cul-de-sac in Dybvad, North Jutland. Modernised step by step, most recently in 2026 with new anthracite wood-alu windows and doors. Works as a family home or a summer base near the Kattegat coast. Listed at DKK 745,000. EU citizens who move to Denmark can buy freely; others need permission from the Ministry of Justice.

rows.title: Move-in-ready town house in Vinderup for €65k
rows.why_great: An 84 m² house kept in good order, ready to move in, in the centre of Vinderup, close to shops and the school and near Hjerl Hede open-air museum and Flyndersø lake. Listed at DKK 485,000. EU citizens who move to Denmark can buy freely; others need permission from the Ministry of Justice.

rows.title: Red cottage with underfloor heating and a heat pump on Funen
rows.why_great: A charming, well-kept 101 m² house in Brenderup on Funen, updated over the years and ready to move in. Air-to-water heat pump from 2017 and underfloor heating downstairs keep it warm and cheap to run. Pretty walled garden. Listed at DKK 595,000. EU citizens who move to Denmark can buy freely; others need permission from the Ministry of Justice.

rows.title: Neat modernised house backing onto green fields in Stoholm
rows.why_great: 70 m² plus a 50 m² basement, modernised kitchen and bathroom, open kitchen-living room with direct access to a terrace and a garden that backs onto green fields. In Stoholm, between Skive and Viborg. Listed at DKK 645,000. EU citizens who move to Denmark can buy freely; others need permission from the Ministry of Justice.

rows.title: Garden house with arbor and garage on the Canadian border
rows.why_great: A 1943 house with three bedrooms and 1.5 baths in about 124 m². Recent updates: new flooring, new furnace and water heater, new stainless kitchen appliances. Pretty garden with an arbor and a detached garage, near the school and sports fields in Madawaska, Maine, across the river from Canada. That is about €79,300.

rows.title: Acadian coast house with 4 bedrooms and a new bathroom
rows.why_great: A 1.5-storey house of about 107 m² in Grande-Anse on New Brunswick's Acadian coast, by the Bay of Chaleur. The main floor has been updated, with a bright living room, a big kitchen and a fully renovated bathroom; two of the four bedrooms keep their original character upstairs. Asking price CAD 159,000. That is about €99,500. Canada's ban on foreign buyers applies in cities and towns of 10,000+ people until 1 January 2027; ask the agent whether it applies here.

rows.title: A white village home with a Sierra de Baza roof terrace
rows.pick_note: Selected for its roof terrace, open mountain view and white village facade.
rows.why_great: A sunny roof terrace looks across the green valley towards the Sierra de Baza. This two-storey home combines conventional rooms with cave rooms extending through the hillside, with entrances on both sides. The listing describes four bedrooms, three bathrooms, fireplaces and a carport, and says it is ready to move into. Interiors are traditional rather than recently styled. Baza is around 15 minutes away by car.

Interiors retain traditional, modest finishes.

Holiday cottage with winter garden by a bathing lake in Salgesch
rows.why_great: About 40 m² on a plot of around 180 m² at Camping Swissplage, with a winter garden, an outdoor seating area for barbecues and a garden shed. The campsite has a bathing lake, a restaurant, a playground and a small animal enclosure, in the wine village of Salgesch between Sierre and Leuk. Parking is public (120 m away) or a private space can be rented. Campsite pitch, so a yearly fee applies. Asking price CHF 49,000, about €52,800. Buying in Switzerland as a non-resident foreigner is limited by the Lex Koller rules; ask the agent whether you qualify before you go further.

rows.title: Winter-proof wooden chalet by a stream in the Valais Alps
rows.why_great: A 2.5-room chalet of about 48 m² in a quiet corner of the 4-star Camping Santa Monica in Raron, right on the stream, usable all year. Kitchen with dishwasher and gas hob, fly screens on every window, a covered terrace with an outdoor fireplace, an 8 m² cellar, a laundry room and a small parking space. Last renovated in February 2026. The campsite has a heated pool, a restaurant and a shop, and Zermatt, Saas-Fee and the Aletsch Glacier are day trips away. It stands on a campsite pitch, so expect a yearly pitch fee and the campsite rules. Asking price CHF 69,500, about €74,900. Buying in Switzerland as a non-resident foreigner is limited by the Lex Koller rules; ask the agent whether you qualify before you go further.

rows.title: Bright as-new tiny house with sleeping loft and heat pump
rows.why_great: Built in 2023 and as new: about 20 m² with an open living and dining area, a kitchenette with induction hob, a modern shower room and a sleeping loft under a 3.26 m ceiling. Heated by an air-to-water heat pump, double-glazed and well insulated. Available now and mobile, so it can go on a campsite or a suitable plot under the local rules. Shown near Brig. Asking price CHF 55,000, about €59,300. Buying in Switzerland as a non-resident foreigner is limited by the Lex Koller rules; ask the agent whether you qualify before you go further.

rows.title: Mobile home with 120 m² garden, gazebo and pellet heating in Valais
rows.why_great: The 'Bijou' mobile home: 34 m² of living space plus a veranda, on a 213 m² plot with about 120 m² of garden, a gazebo with lounge and an outdoor fireplace. Granite kitchen worktop, shower room, pellet heating with underfloor heating and a pellet stove. Built in 2000, renovated in 2015 and sold with all furniture. It sits at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac at Camping Santa Monica in Raron, with the campsite pool, golf in Leuk and the ski areas nearby. Campsite rules and a yearly fee apply. Asking price CHF 79,700, about €85,900. Buying in Switzerland as a non-resident foreigner is limited by the Lex Koller rules; ask the agent whether you qualify before you go further.

rows.title: Renovated chalet with garden in a green campsite in the Neuchâtel hills
rows.why_great: A renovated 1.5-room chalet of about 30 m² on a plot of around 150 m², with large sliding windows, a new kitchen and a shower room. The campsite has a pool, a playground, a padel court and a supermarket 50 m away, and the bus is 150 m away. The land rent is CHF 2,400 a year. Leisure or second-home use only, not a main residence. Asking price CHF 65,000, about €70,100. Buying in Switzerland as a non-resident foreigner is limited by the Lex Koller rules; ask the agent whether you qualify before you go further.

rows.title: Wooden tiny house with two lofts and a wood stove, ready to move
rows.why_great: A newly built tiny house: about 25 m² with an open living area, a custom kitchen with induction hob and oven, a shower room with flush toilet, two sleeping lofts and ceilings up to 3.26 m. Infrared underfloor heating plus a wood-burning stove, spruce facade and an insulated roof. It sits on a light trailer (7.3 × 2.55 m), so you place it on a campsite or a plot where the rules allow it. Shown near Brig. Asking price CHF 55,000, about €59,300. Buying in Switzerland as a non-resident foreigner is limited by the Lex Koller rules; ask the agent whether you qualify before you go further.

rows.title: 70 m² modular house with heat pump, to move to your own plot
rows.why_great: Four solid living modules under a classic pitched roof, about 70 m² gross: kitchen with fridge and oven, a bright open living and dining room, and a bathroom with shower, toilet and washing machine.
